多智能体系统

[MA-0] ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在业务流程自动化中因频繁调用大语言模型（LLM）而带来的高延迟与高成本问题。传统LLM代理在执行标准操作程序（SOP）时，每一步决策均依赖于LLM重新生成，导致效率低下且难以规模化。其解决方案的关键在于提出ReTrace框架，通过分析少量已记录的代理运行轨迹，自动提取每个步骤背后的逻辑条件，将这些条件合并为紧凑的规则文档，并基于规则生成可执行的工作流。该工作流以代码形式实现步骤选择，不再依赖LLM进行每步决策，从而显著降低计算开销。此外，该方法具备平台无关性，规则文档可编译适配不同编排平台；通过引入对训练失败案例的修复机制，进一步提升了任务成功率与稳定性，在多个基准测试中表现出优于或接近原生代理的性能，同时大幅降低单任务成本与执行时间。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14492
作者: Kaiyuan Hou,Yang Ping Kuo,Indranil Bhattacharya,Rohith Nama,Arushi Gupta,Carlos D. Castillo,Prathap Ramachandra,Xiaofan Jiang,Francesco Carbone
机构: Columbia University (哥伦比亚大学); Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent’s reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On 79 procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach 93.8% completion, against 96.8% for the agent, at 24% lower cost per task. On \tau^2 -Bench, they reach 75.8% task success (agent: 80.6% ) and run in 1.3 s instead of 170 s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift k=2 workflows from 66.7% to 81.2% . On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ( 80.6% vs. 83.6% ), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to 87.8% at 0.40 s per task, compared to 85.5% in 46.6 s for the agent.

[MA-1] Dont Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents ACL

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在使用外部记忆进行经验学习时可能出现的“记忆诱发退化”（memory-induced degradation）问题。具体而言，当智能体依赖从历史任务轨迹中提炼出的简短经验教训（lesson）时，若这些教训本身存在错误、被误用或误解，反而会导致其在原本能够解决的任务上失败。根本原因在于，这些教训仅基于任务成功或失败的标签生成，且在后续使用中通常不附带原始轨迹信息，使智能体无法验证或修正教训的可靠性。为应对这一挑战，论文提出WikiTrace——一种基于证据链接的外部记忆系统，其核心创新在于将每个教训与原始轨迹的摘要及原始数据本身进行绑定，从而实现可追溯性与可验证性。在新任务执行过程中，智能体可从所有已存储的见解出发，当某一见解缺乏行动所需细节、与其他见解冲突，或源自失败任务时，通过链接调用终端工具回溯原始轨迹，以补充信息或修正见解。实验在五个代理型基准测试中验证了WikiTrace的有效性，结果表明其不仅显著优于现有记忆方法和仅依赖相同见解的基线，还能有效缓解记忆诱发退化现象。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14320
作者: Yukyeong Lee,Yumin Choi,Jinheon Baek,Sung Ju Hwang
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); DeepAuto.ai
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle); under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectories they came from, leaving the agent no way to check them. To address this, we introduce WikiTrace, an evidence-linked memory system designed to let agents check each lesson against its original trajectory. Specifically, motivated by the finding that a trajectory often still holds the evidence needed to catch an erroneous lesson, WikiTrace stores each lesson as a concise insight linked to a summary of why its trajectory succeeded or failed and to the raw trajectory itself. Then, on a new task, the agent starts from all insights and, whenever one lacks details needed to act, conflicts with another, or comes from a failed task, descends through its links with terminal tools to fill in missing details or correct the insight before acting. We validate WikiTrace on five agentic benchmarks, showing that it consistently outperforms existing memory approaches and a baseline given the same insights alone, while also reducing memory-induced degradation. Our code is available at this https URL

[MA-2] Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决智能代理在与人类协商过程中，因通用面部情绪模型在个体间和情境间泛化能力差而导致的情绪感知偏差问题，即“泛化差距”（generalization gap）。其核心解决方案是提出一种情感自适应的协商策略，关键在于引入基于想象的持续学习面部表情识别（Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition, CLIFER），实现对个体效用价值（valence-arousal）的实时个性化感知。通过差异反馈机制，将情绪维度的变化方向与强度转化为代理目标效用的动态调整；同时采用异步架构，在实时交互中后台持续更新CLIFER模型，避免干扰交互流程。实验结果表明，相较于基线方法FaceChannel，该方案显著提升了个体效用和参与者让步率，且在平均唤醒度估计和输出范围上表现更优，验证了持续情感个性化与差异反馈耦合在实时协商中的实际价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14247
作者: Mehmet Onur Keskin,Berk Buzcu,Nikhil Churamani,Reyhan Aydogan,Hatice Gunes,Catholijn Jonker
机构: Özyeğin University (Özyeğin大学); University of Cambridge (剑桥大学); TU Delft (代尔夫特理工大学); HES-SO Valais-Wallis (洛桑联邦理工学院瓦莱-瓦利分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注: 17 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent’s target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.

[MA-3] PARLEY: Evaluating LLM Collaboration Through Cooperative Asymmetric Puzzles

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在作为自主智能体（autonomous agents）协作时，其协作机制与失败模式缺乏系统性理解的问题。为应对这一挑战，研究提出PARLEY平台，通过四个基于认知心理学的非对称谜题任务（参照性沟通、联合协调、观点采择和空间推理）来考察LLM智能体间的协作表现。其解决方案的关键在于：从实际协作对话中提炼出数据驱动的失败类型分类体系——PAC分类法（Perception, Adaptation, Coordination），将六类失败模式归纳为感知、适应与协调三大维度。研究发现，未能有效整合外部反馈是导致协作失败的核心因素，表现为智能体持续重复无效策略。进一步通过基于该分类法的干预措施（N=200），任务成功率由60.5%提升至70.5%，验证了该分类体系在指导智能体协作优化方面的有效性。因此，PARLEY平台不仅提供了评估协作能力的基准框架，更实现了从行为观察到可操作改进路径的数据驱动闭环。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14242
作者: Javier Hernandez,Andrew D. Wilson
机构: Microsoft Research(微软研究院); Microsoft Research(微软研究院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 12 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As large language models power autonomous agents, understanding how they collaborate and where they fail becomes critical. We introduce PARLEY, an extensible platform for studying LLM agent collaboration through four asymmetric puzzle tasks grounded in cognitive psychology (referential communication, joint coordination, perspective-taking, and spatial reasoning). GPT-4o agent pairs succeeded in 60.5% of conversations (N=400, 100 per task), with task-level variation (34-80%) reflecting distinct collaborative demands. From these conversations, we derived the data-driven PAC taxonomy: six failure types organized into Perception (visual interpretation and spatial reasoning), Adaptation (progress tracking and feedback integration), and Coordination (verification and grounding). Failure to incorporate external feedback was a critical indicator of unsuccessful collaboration, with agents repeatedly applying unsuccessful strategies. We also show that a taxonomy-guided intervention (N=200) improved average task success to 70.5%. These results demonstrate how PARLEY can be used to derive meaningful, data-driven insights that can in turn lead to improved agentic collaboration.

[MA-4] Safety and Connectivity Certificates for Finite-Time Formation Transitions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在有限时间形成转移过程中，如何在保证精确有限时间收敛的同时，确保过渡阶段的碰撞规避与通信连通性的问题。现有方法虽能实现有限时间协调与安全约束控制，但缺乏对过渡阶段分歧（disagreement）与形成几何结构、耦合增益选择之间显式关联的理论分析，难以对安全机动进行形式化验证。本文提出一种基于分歧的框架，用于认证任意预设形成轨迹在有限时间跟踪过程中的瞬态安全性和连通性。其核心解决方案包括：局部反馈设计可实现无图依赖的有限时间精确跟踪，并提供统一的收敛时间上界；同时引入图依赖的分歧上界，推导出保证碰撞避免与连通性维持的充分几何条件，进而建立基于可用几何裕度的离线耦合增益选取规则。数值仿真验证了耦合增益增大时收敛速率与控制努力之间的权衡关系，同时展示了所提证书的有效性与保守性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13927
作者: Yash Purswani,Shivansh Agarwal,Anuj Tiwari
机构: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (印度理工学院马德拉斯分校)
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 7 Pages, 2 Figures, under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Finite-time formation transitions are useful for coordinating multi-agent systems in time-critical missions, but convergence to a prescribed formation in finite time does not guarantee collision avoidance or communication connectivity during the transition. Existing approaches address finite-time coordination and safety-constrained formation control, yet explicit connections between disagreement during transitions, formation geometry, and coupling-gain selection need to be developed for certifying safe maneuvers. This paper develops a disagreement-based framework for certifying transient safety and connectivity during finite-time tracking of arbitrary prescribed formation trajectories. Local feedback guarantees exact finite-time tracking with a graph-independent settling-time bound, while a graph-dependent disagreement bound is used to derive sufficient geometric conditions for collision avoidance and connectivity preservation. These conditions further yield an offline coupling-gain selection rule based on the available geometric clearance. Numerical simulations illustrate the trade-off between convergence rate and control effort as the coupling gain increases. They also demonstrate the effectiveness and conservatism of the proposed certificates.

[MA-5] DrugCoding: A Scientific Programming Agent for Drug Discovery

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式AI在复杂药物发现流程中面临的自主任务规划能力不足、专用模型动态选择困难以及多阶段科学计算可靠执行难题。其核心解决方案在于提出DrugCoding——一个集科学任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作与程序化工具执行于一体的科学编程代理系统。该系统通过动态生成和执行代码，实现对专业化科学模型的灵活调用，并借助多智能体协同机制保障复杂科研任务的高效执行与可信验证。实验表明，DrugCoding在跨语言模型与科学工具接口的多轮工具调用任务中，整体会话级Pass@1达到97.35%，显著优于最强基线Codex（提升9.24%），在挑战性子集上更达97.92%，验证了其在复杂药物发现工作流自动化中的优越性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13651
作者: Junwei Hu,Zhuohao Lin,Kun Li,Hengnan Zhang
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Drug discovery involves multiple interconnected research stages, including molecular design, property prediction, and virtual screening. These processes are characterized by complex workflows, interdependent computational tasks, and diverse specialized tools, placing substantial demands on the coordination of scientific models and computational resources. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents still face challenges in autonomous planning of complex tasks, adaptive selection of specialized models, and reliable execution of multi-stage scientific computations, limiting their effectiveness in automating complex drug discovery workflows. To address these challenges, we propose DrugCoding, a scientific programming agent system that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution. DrugCoding enables autonomous task planning and dynamic model adaptation for complex research objectives. It can flexibly invoke specialized scientific models, autonomously generate and execute code according to task requirements, and leverage multi-agent collaboration to support efficient execution and reliable validation of complex scientific tasks. To evaluate DrugCoding’s performance in scientific tool invocation and multi-stage task execution, we conduct multi-turn tool-calling experiments across diverse language models and scientific tool interfaces. Experimental results demonstrate that DrugCoding achieves an average session-level Pass@1 of 97.35% on the full benchmark, outperforming the strongest baseline, Codex, by 9.24%. On the challenging subset, DrugCoding achieves 97.92%, exceeding the strongest baseline.

[MA-6] Do AI Agents need Preventive Care? An Epidemiologic Cohort Design for Agent ic AI

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前生成式 AI（Generative AI）在自主执行任务过程中，其行为演化机制及其对长期结果影响缺乏系统性评估的问题。现有评估方法主要聚焦于模型在预设任务上的性能表现，忽视了对AI代理（AI agent）在真实工作环境中行为动态演变的追踪与因果分析。为此，论文提出一种基于流行病学队列研究设计的框架，将单个AI代理视为队列中的个体，其底层模型类比为“遗传背景”，累积的工作量作为时间尺度，自然产生的行为模式作为潜在暴露因素，进而探究这些行为对后续不良事件的影响。该方案的关键在于引入纵向追踪视角，结合因果推断方法，量化可预防负担，并刻画代理在其“工作生命周期”中行为特征的变化规律。通过两个前瞻性观察队列研究，分别探讨好奇心与试探性行为的安全性问题，以及数据核查与分析准确性所反映的可靠性问题，验证了该框架的可操作性与普适性，为构建可推广的AI代理流行病学研究体系提供了理论基础与实践蓝图。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13333
作者: Shu Jiang,Graham A. Colditz
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As AI agents increasingly perform tasks autonomously across sectors, including healthcare and biomedical research, understanding how their behaviors develop and influence outcomes over time becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations largely focus on model capabilities and performance on predefined tasks. Here, we propose an epidemiologic cohort design for studying agentic AI, drawing on principles established in human population studies. The framework treats individual agents as members of a cohort, their underlying model as genetic makeup, accumulated work as their time scale, and naturally occurring behaviors as exposures that may influence subsequent outcomes. By following agents longitudinally, this approach enables investigation of behavioral determinants of adverse events, estimation of their potential preventable burden under causal assumptions, and characterization of behavioral changes over an agent’s work life. We illustrate the design through two prospective observational cohorts examining curiosity and probing as a safety question, and data checking and analytical accuracy as a reliability question. Together, the framework and illustrative studies provide a generalizable blueprint for designing epidemiologic cohorts of AI agents.

[MA-7] From Process Models to Composable Agent ic Workflows: Combining BPMN Agents and Enterprise Knowledge

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的智能体（agent）在构建复杂协同应用时面临的可理解性、可监控性和可优化性难题。随着智能体任务逻辑分散于提示词（prompt）、工具调用及应用代码中，工作流呈现隐式结构，导致系统难以调试与维护。为此，论文提出**递归能力组合（Recursive Capability Composition）**作为核心解决方案，通过将业务流程建模为基于BPMN（Business Process Model and Notation）的显式工作流，实现对多智能体系统执行过程的可视化与可控化。其关键在于：利用LangGraph/Pregel运行时将语义丰富的SemTalk BPMN模型转化为可执行的智能体工作流，其中智能体任务（Agentic Tasks）在特定节点引入大语言模型推理能力，而传统BPMN元素则负责处理确定性流程控制、决策判断、系统交互和人工审批等环节；同时，通过将智能体行为或可执行流程封装为可复用的智能体工具（Agentic Tools），支持跨任务的能力复用与组合。此外，论文融合组织特有的流程模型与知识图谱（Knowledge Graph），为智能体提供结构化的企业上下文知识，从而增强其决策合理性。整体贡献体现在三个方面：模型驱动的执行、递归能力组合机制以及企业级上下文支持，显著提升了智能体系统的透明度、可管理性与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13196
作者: Christian Fillies,Jan Fillies,Frauke Weichhardt,Gay Anne Wood-Albrecht
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 14 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based agents can reason, use tools and collaborate. However, coordinating increasingly complex agentic applications becomes difficult to understand, monitor and improve. Decisions distributed across prompts, tool calls and application logic make workflows implicit. We introduce Recursive Capability Composition, enabling agents to execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools. This paper presents a BPMN-based approach to Agentic Workflows, combining explicit orchestration with autonomous reasoning. SemTalk BPMN models are transformed into executable workflows using a LangGraph/Pregel runtime. Agentic Tasks introduce LLM reasoning at selected activities, while conventional BPMN controls process flows, deterministic decisions, system interactions and human approvals. Agentic Participants provide reusable interfaces for agent behavior or other executable processes. BPMN orchestration makes multi-agent systems more understandable and manageable. Explicit process models provide developers and operators with a shared view of workflow structures and execution progress, facilitating debugging, monitoring and optimization. Enterprise agents also need organization-specific context. Process Models and Knowledge Graphs describe activities, participants, information objects, decisions and relationships between processes. They provide structured knowledge of how an organization operates, supporting informed agent decisions and actions. Our contributions are threefold: 1. Model-Driven Execution: Transforming BPMN models into executable Agentic Workflows. 2. Recursive Capability Composition: Exposing agents and executable business processes as reusable tools for other agents. 3. Enterprise Context: Using Process Models and Ontologies to provide organization-specific knowledge for agent reasoning. [MA-8] Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决闭环自主实验系统在物理仪器上长期稳定运行的难题，尤其是如何降低其实施门槛以提升科学发现效率。其核心解决方案在于构建基于可验证科学方法的编码代理（coding-agent）基础设施，实现对纳米粒子超晶格在同步辐射X射线实验中的自主控制与动态目标调整。关键创新点在于通过完整的人-代理及代理-代理交互记录，实现了决策过程的可追溯性（provenance），并量化分析了认知劳动分工：在三轮实验中，46%至67%的通信内容涉及解释或判断，且方法论与科学贡献比例从首轮的46%逐步上升至56%-61%，表明系统在迭代过程中逐渐增强自主科学决策能力；同时，59%-68%的错误修正涉及多方协作，约一半决策采纳了至少一名其他参与者的输入，凸显了多代理协同机制在保障可靠性与创新能力方面的价值。该研究为多代理科学系统的设计、代理模型训练策略及可访问的自主实验平台发展提供了实证依据与设计原则。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12933
作者: Gunik Luthra,Ronald J. Pandolfi,Benjamin T. Diroll,Ricky Ronquillo,Ruipeng Li,Christopher B. Murray,Marcus M. Noack,Kevin G. Yager,Esther H. R. Tsai
机构: Brookhaven National Laboratory (布鲁克海文国家实验室); Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室); Argonne National Laboratory (阿贡国家实验室); University of Pennsylvania (宾夕法尼亚大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Closed-loop autonomous experimentation can accelerate scientific discovery, but implementation effort limits accessibility. Agentic systems may lower this barrier, although sustained operation on physical instruments remains largely unexplored. Here, using coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods, we demonstrate autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. Complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts enable an audit that reconstructs decision provenance and characterizes the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while the share of methodological and scientific contributions increased from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56-61% in later experiments. Provenance showed that 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants and that about half of all decisions incorporated the input of another participant. These results may guide design principles for multi-agent scientific systems and inform future agent harnesses, model training, and accessible autonomous experimentation.

[MA-9] Spatial patterns of transportation choice in Niterói

【速读】：该论文旨在解决城市交通流动态特征难以通过高时空分辨率数据获取的问题，其核心挑战在于如何在缺乏个体层面精细轨迹数据的情况下，构建具有微观动态特性的城市出行模拟模型。解决方案的关键在于提出一种计算框架，该框架利用宏观、聚合且静态的城市数据（如建成环境、交通网络与合成人口），结合现有活动模拟器，生成具有空间细节和时间动态性的个体出行行为。通过将合成人口与实际城市结构融合，模型能够模拟居民每日通勤路径，并合理分配步行、驾车或公共交通等出行方式。应用该框架对巴西尼泰罗伊市约47.5万名合成居民的模拟结果显示，其分区域的交通模式与实证活动指标高度相关（皮尔逊相关系数r=0.885），揭示了城市中心区步行比例更高、外围地区私家车使用增加、公交走廊仍保持较高公交分担率的空间规律。此外，通过缩短至公交站点的步行时间30%，模型显示公交/私家车出行比提升11.3%，尤其在边缘区域效应更显著，表明改善公交可达性可有效促进公共交通使用。该方法为在数据受限条件下实现精细化城市交通模拟提供了可行路径，并识别出优化交通政策的关键空间节点。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14499
作者: Sandro Martinelli Reia,Taylor Anderson,Dieter Pfoser
机构: George Mason University (乔治梅森大学); Center for Geospatial Intelligence (地理空间智能中心)
类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Other Statistics (stat.OT)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Characterizing how people move through a city requires spatially and temporally fine-grained data that are often costly and difficult to obtain. Here, we introduce a computational framework that uses macroscopic, aggregated, and static urban data to construct a microscopic, dynamic, and spatially detailed representation of urban mobility. Building on an existing activity simulator, the framework combines a synthetic population, the built environment, and transport networks to generate daily trips and assign walking, car, or public transit. Applied to approximately 475,000 synthetic residents of Niterói, Brazil, simulated neighborhood-level transit patterns show a strong association with an empirical activity proxy (Pearson r=0.885). Walking is more prevalent in compact central areas, car use increases toward the periphery, and public-transit use remains comparatively high along bus corridors. Reducing walking times to and from bus stops by 30% increases the modeled public-transit-to-car ratio by 11.3%, with larger transit-share gains in several peripheral areas. These results reveal spatial differences in transportation choice and identify where improved transit access may have the greatest modeled effect.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决强化学习中因仅使用结果奖励（outcome rewards）而导致训练过程中大量中间信息被浪费的问题。传统方法将每一轮尝试简化为单一数值奖励，忽略了丰富的过程性经验，从而限制了模型的学习效率与泛化能力。为此，本文提出AutoScaffold——一种面向AI的统一自适应框架，其核心在于通过一个冻结的教师模型（frozen teacher）自动分析学生模型在训练过程中的经验，识别瓶颈并动态生成两类可适应的辅助结构（scaffolds）：(i) 适用于任务类别的通用策略；(ii) 针对个别困难任务的提示（hints），且根据学生的学习进展自动调整支持的内容与强度。这些辅助结构在评估阶段被移除，确保最终性能不受干扰。关键创新点在于无需人工干预或领域特定知识，即可实现从训练经验到智能引导机制的自动化转化。实验表明，在ALFWorld、基于搜索的问答、数学推理和GPU内核生成等多个任务上，采用AutoScaffold训练的学生模型均显著优于基准方法，尤其在成功率与准确率方面取得明显提升，且分析揭示教师能够随学习进程动态调整策略，有效促进学生更高效地掌握任务本质。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14515
作者: Zijian Zhang,Rizhen Hu,Jiangweizhi Peng,Shiyang Li,Sujay Bhatt,Sihan Zeng,Mingyi Hong
机构: University of Minnesota, Twin Cities (明尼苏达大学双城分校); JPMorgan AI Research (摩根大通人工智能研究)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student’s training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA’s reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.

[NLP-1] Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在开放式、数据驱动的科学发现中因采用点对点（pointwise）假设检验方式而产生的认知局限性：即当某个假设 $ h $ 被证据否定时，代理仅能得知该解释不成立，却无法明确识别出被证据所支持的替代解释。其核心解决方案是提出“对比发现”（Contrastive Discovery），通过将单一假设替换为一个对比集（contrast set），即一个科学问题及其互斥且穷尽的多个竞争性解释构成的集合。每个实验的证据通过其在对比集中重新分配信念的程度进行评分，当信念集中于某一解释时，问题即被解决。该方法仅改变代理的命题与评估单位，无需修改现有框架，因而可无缝应用于已有证据的再评估或指导新实验搜索。在六个领域中的实验证明，89% 的点对点候选者在最大信念转移后被拒绝，而使用对比集可在相同证据下将其中73% 的问题明确解析至具体替代解释；在搜索引导场景中，对比集使代理在相同实验预算下比基于点对点意外性（surprisal）的方法多解决67%的问题。盲测研究显示，38名人类专家在78%的已解决问题及82%的点对点代理拒绝假设后停止的问题中，均选择了相同的解释。这些结果表明，显式引入竞争性解释作为对比集，显著提升了发现代理从相同证据和验证预算中解析更多科学问题的能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14514
作者: Ziang Liu,James J. Kim,Yijia Dai,Jennifer J. Sun
机构: Cornell University (康奈尔大学); codiscovery.ai/contrastive-discovery
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 55 pages. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim h only against its complement \neg h . When evidence rejects h , the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, 89% of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve 73% of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves 67% more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, 38 human experts chose the same explanation on 78% of resolved questions and on 82% of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.

[NLP-2] Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability Detection and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents KDD2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决企业在部署基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的分析代理时，如何在复杂的多工具工作流中可靠检测潜在故障的问题。现有评估框架在面对复杂系统时存在稳定性不足、误报率高及对隐蔽错误识别能力弱等缺陷。其解决方案的关键在于提出并对比三种不同评估范式：基于执行轨迹的LLM判断、仅依赖文本输入的LLM判断结合红队测试（red-teaming），以及确定性启发式规则。研究通过三阶段实验发现，基于轨迹的评估框架在功能错误检测中表现出最佳的精确率-召回率平衡（F1=0.90），而纯文本评估虽具备较高召回率但产生五倍于前者的误报；更重要的是，在未知风险发现方面，功能性测试与安全红队测试揭示了24个无重叠的新故障，证明二者具有互补性。研究结果表明，评估质量取决于评估框架可获取的信息类型，且基于LLM的评估能捕捉人类审查者难以察觉的细微缺陷。因此，推荐采用“双框架策略”：以基于轨迹的评估进行功能验证，以对抗性红队测试保障安全性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14493
作者: Howard Zhang,Chuck Arvin,Logan Brown,Mihir Bhatia,Neelu Choudhary,Lily Miao
机构: Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: Accepted to KDD 2026, Jeju, Korea. 9 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.

[NLP-3] Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）模型内部复杂计算过程的可解释性问题，即如何从神经网络的内部表征中推断出能够解释模型行为的机制性原理。其核心挑战在于，尽管机械可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability, MI）技术已能识别出与模型行为相关的神经元、特征、电路结构及动态模式，但如何基于这些观测结果构建可靠且可推广的机制性解释仍存在显著瓶颈。解决方案的关键在于提出一套五项原则，并将其整合为一种递归逻辑框架，以实现更严谨的机制推断流程。该框架不仅有助于将局部的可解释性发现转化为模型内部机制的累积性知识体系，还能使所推导出的机制具备足够精确性，从而生成可验证的、超越模型本身的外部域假设，最终推动科学发现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14483
作者: Zhimin Hu,Chen Jiang,Hanbo Xie,N.Apurva Ratan Murty,Sashank Varma
机构: Georgia Tech(佐治亚理工学院); McGill University(麦吉尔大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: NeurIPS 2026 Interp4Discovery (Oral)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanistic interpretability (MI) has made it possible to identify neurons, features, circuits, population structures, and dynamical patterns associated with model behavior. As these tools improve, attention is shifting from what can be observed inside a model to how those observations support mechanistic explanations. We examine the parallel efforts of neuroscience and MI to address this question and identify recurring inferential bottlenecks when inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems. We propose five principles and organize them into a recursive logic for a more rigorous procedure of mechanistic inference. These principles provide a framework that supports scientific discovery in two senses: it helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative knowledge of mechanisms within models, and it makes those mechanisms sufficiently precise to generate testable hypotheses about domains beyond the models. Evidence beyond MI is ultimately required to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.

[NLP-4] Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决机器翻译自动质量评估中的两个关键问题：段落级质量评分预测（segment-level quality score prediction）以及无错误段落的检测（error-free segment detection）。针对这些问题，其解决方案的核心在于提出一种名为Pterodactyl的可高度定制、超低成本的系统，该系统专为翻译筛选（translation triage）与数据清洗（data curation）中的二分类任务优化。其关键技术路径是基于大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）的范式，通过受ROC分析指导的提示工程（prompt engineering）与模型选择策略，显著提升分类性能，同时保持极低的计算成本。此外，研究还开发了多个针对子任务3的Pterodactyl变体，以进一步增强特定任务的适应性与准确性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14480
作者: Evelyn Y. Garland,Carola F. Berger
机构: 1020 Group; Acta Language Services, LLC; CFB Scientific Translations LLC
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 6 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In this paper, we present 1020 Group’s submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, was engineered specifically for subtasks 2 and 3, that is, segment-level quality score prediction and the detection of error-free segments. Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. We also developed several variants of Pterodactyl that were specifically adapted for subtasks 3.

[NLP-5] When does text encoding matter for language modeling?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决因字节级语言模型普遍采用可变长度编码（如UTF-8）而导致的跨语言不平等性问题，探究文本编码策略对模型性能的影响。其关键解决方案在于提出Aether——一种混合编码方案，结合特定语系的优化编码与UTF-8的全Unicode覆盖回退机制，在保持兼容性的同时实现对四种书写系统差异显著语言的建模。研究发现，字符信息密度高的语言（如中文、韩文）从压缩型编码中获益显著，而单个字符信息量较低的语言（如格鲁吉亚语、泰米尔语）则对编码方式不敏感。因此，论文主张文本编码应作为语言特异性设计决策，而非默认的统一标准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14459
作者: Eugene Jang,Catherine Arnett,Terra Blevins
机构: Khoury College of Computer Sciences, Northeastern University (东北大学计算机科学学院); EleutherAI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:UTF-8’s role as the de facto encoding standard in language models introduces cross-lingual inequities due to its variable-length design. However, the effect that this encoding choice has on model performance remains largely unexamined. In this work, we investigate how text encoding impacts the performance of byte-level language models, comparing UTF-8 with a wide range of other encoding strategies, including other Unicode-based approaches, language-specific encodings, and our own customized encodings. To facilitate our analysis, we propose Aether: a hybrid encoding scheme that uses script-specific encodings for our target setting while maintaining full Unicode coverage through UTF-8 fallbacks, using this framework to model four orthographically diverse languages. Surprisingly, we find that while languages with information-dense characters (Chinese, Korean) significantly benefit from compressive encodings, languages whose characters carry less information individually (Georgian, Tamil) are largely insensitive to encoding choice. In light of these findings, we argue that text encoding should be a language-specific design decision, rather than a universal default.

[NLP-6] Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决流式语音识别（streaming speech recognition）中响应延迟过高的问题，即传统模型通常在说话人完成一个词后90–400毫秒才输出对应词汇，导致语音助手无法及时启动搜索或生成回复。其核心解决方案是提出Earlybird——一个仅29M参数、4比特量化后仅16.8 MB的轻量级流式识别器，通过在训练时使用随机截断的音频（包括单词进行中的片段），并要求模型预测截至当前时刻应输出的所有完整词汇及接下来两个词汇的预测，从而实现对未完成词汇的提前识别。该方法利用原始令牌概率直接生成每个词（包括正在发音的词）的置信度，使模型具备对未结束词的实时置信度评估能力。实验结果表明，在干净有声书语料（LibriSpeech test-clean）上，Earlybird可将词汇的中位预测时间提前90毫秒，且69%的词汇在发音结束前被正确预测，显著优于现有流式模型（3–25%）。此外，其置信度校准良好，预期校准误差（ECE）为3.7至5.5，在八个英语开放语音识别排行榜数据集上表现优于同规模的Moonshine Tiny，并与Whistle模型相当。

Abstract:Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. On clean audiobook speech (LibriSpeech test-clean), the median word is predicted correctly 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, while released streaming models get it 90 to 400 ms after it ends. Earlybird is the earliest on all six test sets we time, covering audiobooks, TED talks, public speech, earnings calls, and synthetic speech. On the same audiobooks, 69% of words are predicted correctly before they end, against 3-25% for the other models. For words still being spoken, confidence is calibrated, with an expected calibration error (ECE) of 3.7 to 5.5. On the eight English Open ASR Leaderboard sets, it is more accurate than Moonshine Tiny on every set and roughly ties Whistle, a model of the same size.

[NLP-7] Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averag ing in small local language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在低精度量化（low-bit quantization）下，生成式模型因权重压缩导致的选项位置偏差（answer-slot skew）加剧问题，同时探究在固定计算预算内，采用更精细的权重位数还是通过多轮选项重排（cyclic order averaging）来提升模型鲁棒性与性能的最优策略。其核心问题是：低比特量化是否恶化了对答案选项顺序敏感的问题？在资源受限条件下，哪种方式更高效？解决方案的关键在于通过模拟量化（round-to-nearest）与多轮选项重排相结合的方法，在保持模型精度的同时实现成本最优。研究发现，6比特量化可维持与fp16相当的性能，而4比特时出现显著的选项位置偏差，但通过平均四个循环重排的输出，可在0.6B模型上恢复高达+12.6分的性能增益。进一步地，作者以“读取权重字节数×推理遍次数”为统一成本单位进行权衡分析，结果表明：当权重精度达到6比特及以上时，将剩余预算用于增加最多四次选项重排（每次一通）的收益优于继续增加位数；最终决策表建议：优先使用6比特权重，并将余下预算分配给最多四次选项重排。该研究首次系统探讨了量化与选项顺序处理的协同效应，且实验基于两个小型模型和最简量化器，未见此前相关工作。

作者: Mohammed Nayeem Khan,Logesh L,Aliyas Ahmad Misri
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 15 figures, 9 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.

[NLP-8] REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中大语言模型（LLM）推理加速时，基于推测解码（speculative decoding）的预期接受长度（Expected Acceptance Length, EAL）优化不足的问题。现有方法虽引入块级训练目标以直接优化EAL，但其本质仍为EAL的近似代理，存在协方差偏差（covariance gap），导致梯度方向可能被错误引导。本文提出REAL（Real EAL loss），其关键在于通过路径权重（path weights）实现无偏估计，并结合Rao-Blackwellization进行方差缩减，从而精确建模真实EAL。实验表明，在9个任务子集与5个评估种子下，REAL显著优于WTV、VSD、DBLast及静态LK基线，在概率服务接受长度上取得一致提升；且仅需修改训练损失函数，无需调整推测模型架构或推理流程，验证了真实EAL训练在实际应用中的可行性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14399
作者: Yu Tian
机构: The University of Hong Kong (香港大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 19 pages, 10 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at this https URL.

[NLP-9] Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）在延迟敏感任务中推理速度受限的问题。尽管现有方法采用具有自编辑能力的分块扩散机制，通过逐块迭代优化提升生成质量，但其固有串行性导致每个块必须等待前一个块中最慢的令牌完成处理后才能启动，严重制约了整体效率。为此，论文提出一种名为“模糊块边界”（Blurring the Block Boundaries, B3）的新方法，其核心创新在于通过共享前向传播过程，实现两个相邻块的并行精细化处理，同时动态校准进度——仅在模型准备好生成下一区块时才开启。B3无需训练且无超参数调优，可无缝集成至任意自编辑分块扩散模型中。在10个涵盖多种任务与难度级别的基准数据集上的实验表明，B3在保持与基线相当生成质量的前提下，实现了11.5%至14.5%的推理加速，显著优化了生成延迟与质量之间的帕累托前沿。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14387
作者: Amir Mann,Jonathan Fhima,Shaked Brody,Or Avitan,Asif Zamir,Shahar Tsiper,Niv Nayman
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as effective alternatives to autoregressive models for latency-critical tasks, enabling faster token generation. Recent advances employ block diffusion with self-editing capabilities, where each block refines tokens iteratively before advancing to the next one. Yet each block is only as fast as its slowest token, and the next block cannot start before it. We suggest Blurring the Block Boundaries (B3), a novel method with which two blocks are refined in parallel within a shared forward pass. B3 calibrates itself on the fly, opening the next block only once the model is ready to start generating it. It is a training-free and hyperparameter-free acceleration method which seamlessly integrates within any self-editing block diffusion model. Evaluated on state-of-the-art DLMs across 10 diverse datasets spanning varied tasks and difficulty levels, B3 results in on par generation quality and 11.5-14.5% speedup compared to the base model, pushing the Pareto frontier for latency-quality trade-offs in DLM inference.

[NLP-10] ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前研究型智能体（research agent）在基准测试中表现优异，但实际应用于持续性科研项目时可靠性不足的问题。现有基准普遍聚焦于独立、封闭的任务与整洁的工作环境，忽视了真实科研场景中任务依赖历史决策、工作空间包含未完成文件、过时版本及失败尝试等复杂上下文的现实挑战。为此，论文提出ARE-bench，一个基于真实研究人员会话和完整工作区的评估基准，用于检验智能体在持续项目中推进任务的能力，同时尊重先前决策和现有工作区状态。其核心创新在于：构建了75个源自真实科研项目的工作流任务，覆盖七个研究阶段、33项核心需求与150个子需求，共含1,173项二元检查清单；每个任务均锚定于真实用户请求，保留原始需求，并以背景形式总结前序有效指令；完整工作区被回放至任务边界，不进行清理，确保历史痕迹与物质性要求（historical and material requirements）得以保留。检查清单基于意图对齐的评分标准设计，只要求有效解决方案即可得分。实验表明，七种前沿模型在仅考虑交付契约与通用规范时平均通过率约69%，但一旦引入历史与工作区约束，通过率骤降至28.4%–40.0%，且“设计”与“执行”阶段成为所有模型中最难通过的环节。这表明，忽略上下文约束的评估会显著高估智能体能力，掩盖其真实性能差异。因此，该研究的关键解决方案在于建立一种嵌入真实科研情境、保留历史状态与物质痕迹、并严格验证多层级上下文依赖要求的评估范式，从而更真实地衡量研究型智能体在持续项目中的实际交付能力。

Abstract:Research agents achieve increasingly strong benchmark scores, yet these scores do not necessarily translate into reliable delivery in ongoing research projects. Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces. However, researchers ask agents to complete one step within an ongoing project, where requests depend on earlier session decisions and workspaces contain unfinished files, outdated versions, and failed attempts. We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, grounded in real session context and in-progress workspaces. ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers’ own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total. Each task is anchored at a real user request, preserves its requirements, and summarizes the earlier requests still in effect as background. The complete workspace is replayed to that boundary without cleanup, preserving artifacts from earlier turns. Each checklist is compiled from an intent-aligned rubric and credits any valid solution. Across seven frontier models, the strongest passes every checklist item on only 66.2% of tasks, and Design and Execution rank among the hardest stages for every model. Three models pass about 69% of tasks when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked, but just 28.4% to 40.0% once historical and material or workspace requirements are also checked. Evaluating delivery without these contextual requirements can therefore overestimate research agents and mask differences between them.

[NLP-11] EngineAgent : Agent izing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在异构移动硬件上支持新型大语言模型（LLM）进行本地推理时，因模型架构快速演进与硬件多样性导致的系统性挑战。核心问题在于，新模型的部署需在模型转换、图构建、算子实现及硬件后端等多个层级间进行协调更新，而现有编码代理往往忽视跨层依赖关系，难以有效诊断主机-设备执行路径中的故障。其解决方案的关键是提出EngineAgent这一智能体系统，通过将可复用的引擎与硬件知识与特定模型实现相分离，构建分层感知的引擎索引以捕捉抽象层级与跨层依赖，并基于已支持模型预先验证后端的编译、执行与调试流程。在新模型启用过程中，构建器利用该知识协调跨层变更，审计器则通过设备端验证确保实现完整性并驱动迭代调试。实验表明，在涵盖三个移动LLM与四种引擎-后端组合（CPU/GPU/NPU）的12项任务中，EngineAgent实现了75%的端到端成功率，显著优于最强基线（33.3%），且在编译、设备执行及输出logit一致性方面均满足要求；同时相较基线显著降低单任务耗时与模型API成本。

机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Alibaba Group (阿里巴巴集团)
类目: Operating Systems (cs.OS); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host–device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine–backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.

[NLP-12] MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making MDM

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有生成式决策模型在复杂、真实场景下的泛化能力评估不足的问题，尤其针对长上下文、大规模选项空间及复杂逻辑依赖等挑战。现有基准测试常因测试材料的预先暴露而难以准确衡量模型的真正泛化性能，且未能充分整合多类现实决策任务。为此，本文提出MMDM（Massive Multitask Decision Making）基准，包含5,448个高质量问题，覆盖16类任务，涵盖单选、多选和软标签决策，融合新构建任务与基于源文本重构的任务，以实现对真实情境下系统性决策能力的全面评估。其关键解决方案在于构建一个高保真、多样化且具有挑战性的评估框架，涵盖从代理状态追踪、工具与技能选择到偏好判断与评分规则应用等复杂场景，支持高达1,024个选项和64,817词元的输入长度。通过在该基准上对28个决策模型的系统评估发现，尽管多数模型在常识任务上表现良好，但在涉及选项间逻辑依赖、约束规划和多选任务时显著退化，凸显出联合推理、约束感知选择和完整多选恢复作为未来决策模型发展的核心方向。MMDM因此成为推动该领域进步的重要测试平台。

作者: Junhao Shen,Qing Zong,Yue Guo,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Hong Cheng
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; LIGHTSPEED
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
