点击查看摘要

Abstract:System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.

[NLP-13] Semantic Chains: From Reachable Facts to Justified Answers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决如何从问题中识别出支持答案的逻辑事实，并将其组织为一系列相互关联的陈述，以形成连贯的推理链条。其核心问题是：在给定问题与答案之间，如何通过可追溯的逻辑路径，将支撑性事实从根节点逐步传递至与问题和答案共享的对象，从而实现对答案的合理解释。解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于逻辑事实的图结构（graph of logical facts），其中每个父事实通过子事实之间的关系表达更复杂的语义，而“保持边”（preserving edge）则确保子事实的内容能够在父事实的完整表示中被准确恢复。在此模型下，若存在一条由保持边构成的路径，从能够完全支持答案的根事实通向一个同时出现在问题和答案中的共享对象，则可通过从问题中的实体出发进行搜索，逆向追踪至根事实，并覆盖所选推理扩展中的所有事实。最终，根事实可生成一段文本作为单一连接链，将问题与完整答案关联起来并提供正当性依据；对于多链接推理链，论文进一步给出了候选顺序的完整枚举方法，并明确了何种条件下各链接文本能共同维持论证的有效性并支持每一步推理过渡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14252
作者: Misha Andreev
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 31 pages, 10 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How can the facts that justify an answer be found from a question and presented as a sequence of connected statements? This paper models a context as a graph of logical facts and takes as given which expressions represent each fact. A parent fact can express a relation among its subfacts, and a preserving edge allows the content of a subfact to be recovered within a full representation of its parent. Suppose a root fact justifies the full answer and a path of preserving edges leads from that root to a fact that designates an object shared by the question and the answer. Under the conditions of the model, a search starting from the objects in the question reaches the root and covers every fact in the selected expansion. The root then admits a text that forms a single link connecting the question to the full answer and justifying it. For chains with several links, the paper gives a complete enumeration of candidate orders within the stated class and specifies when the link texts jointly preserve the justification and support every transition.

[NLP-14] An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决立法草案中腐败风险识别自动化不足的问题，核心挑战在于如何精准定位可能引发腐败的法律条文条款，并准确识别其对应的监管缺陷。解决方案的关键在于基于TRACE架构构建的多阶段处理流水线：该流水线融合了确定性解析核心、基于大模型（LLM）引导的单条款风险判定、基于规则的因子赋值机制以及外部人工监督，实现了从文本解析到风险标注的系统化流程。实验采用乌克兰反腐败国家局（NAZK）公开结论构建开放基准，涵盖132部草案及474个模型提取的发现。评估结果显示，在100部草案上，使用不同模型的管道系统在严格标准下最高可匹配0.46的发现（非盲测试），显著优于冻结的基线模型（0.21）。主要遗漏原因集中在系统虽定位了条款但将其归类为不同风险类型，且所有32个法律冲突型发现均未被成功匹配。此外，流水线在独立测试集上优于单一提示模板方法（严格标准下），而Opus 5.5并未带来性能提升。最终评分基于大模型判断的发现一致性，其两种访问路径在74个标签中达成73个一致，但尚未经过人类专家验证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14244
作者: Serhii Zabolotnii(Cherkasy State Business College, State Scientific Research Institute of Armament and Military Equipment Testing and Certification, Uzhhorod University),Alina Tarasova(PJSC “Finport Technologies Inc.”)
机构: Cherkasy State Business College (切尔卡西州商业学院); State Scientific Research Institute of Armament and Military Equipment Testing and Certification (乌克兰武装装备与军事设备检测认证国家科研所); Uzhhorod University (乌日霍罗德大学); PJSC “Finport Technologies Inc.” (股份有限公司“Finport Technologies Inc.”)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 18 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine’s National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.

[NLP-15] Dyship: Leverag ing Acoustic Features For Speaker Relationship Classification From Dyadic Conversations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决从双人对话中自动识别说话者熟悉度（speaker familiarity）与亲属关系（kinship）的问题，尤其关注不同语音表征在该任务中的有效性。其核心挑战在于如何从自然对话中提取能够有效反映人际亲疏与血缘关系的声学线索。解决方案的关键在于系统比较五种不同的语音表征：频谱图（spectrograms）、梅尔频率倒谱系数（MFCCs）、自监督预训练模型WavLM表示、x-vectors以及估计的发音运动特征（estimated articulatory movements）。研究发现，频谱特征在熟悉度分类任务中表现最优，准确率达87.81%；而WavLM在亲属关系分类中表现最佳，准确率达到85.17%。值得注意的是，尽管x-vectors和发音运动特征在熟悉度分类中表现较弱，但在亲属关系分类中展现出显著优势，其中x-vectors的AUC达到0.909，远超此前人类专家及音频语言模型的表现。这些结果表明，不同语音表征所捕捉的对话线索存在差异，且传统声学特征在人际关系推断中仍具强大潜力，为后续探索多模态与深度表征在社交关系识别中的应用提供了重要依据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14241
作者: Kieran Sturges,Thomas Thebaud,Yaohan Guan,Najim Dehak
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 5 pages, under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce DyShip, a framework for classifying speaker familiarity and kinship from dyadic conversations in the Seamless Interaction corpus. We compare five speech representations: spectrograms, MFCCs, self-supervised WavLM representations, x-vectors, and estimated articulatory movements. Spectral features perform best for familiarity classification, reaching an accuracy of 87.81%, while WavLM achieves the highest kinship accuracy of 85.17%. X-vectors and articulatory features yield weaker results on familiarity classifiaction, but shine for kinship classification, with an AUC of 0.909 for x-vectors. Most classifiers exceed previously reported human and audio language model scores on the same dataset. These findings highlight the potential of conventional acoustic features for relationship inference and motivate further investigation of the conversational cues captured by different representations.

[NLP-16] Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在处理自然语言中句法结构的可变性与解析歧义时，其内部学习机制缺乏理论解释的问题。尽管已有“事后”研究发现，经过充分训练的Transformer模型能够近似经典的解析算法（如inside-outside算法），但其学习过程如何实现这一能力仍不明确。本文的关键解决方案在于：通过构建具有可变解析树拓扑结构的合成上下文无关文法（Context-Free Grammar, CFG），系统地分析模型在训练过程中的学习动态。该方法的核心优势在于其学习曲线具有完全可解释性——损失的各个阶段不仅可解析计算，且能明确对应到对隐藏潜在树变量（latent tree variable）的表征。通过对模型表示的探针分析，研究揭示了inside-outside计算机制在深度和训练过程中逐步涌现的现象：早期阶段仅依赖局部（二元组/三元组）信息并局限于初始几层，而随着训练推进，Transformer逐渐形成编码-解码结构，中间层负责编码最抽象的潜在信息，后半部分网络则用于逐步优化最终的词元预测。这种计算组织方式与真实世界LLMs中的观察结果相似，且由于实验基于可精确控制数据统计特性的合成模型，为深入理解模型学习机制提供了理论分析的基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14221
作者: Jack T. Parley
机构: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL)(洛桑联邦理工学院); Lausanne, Switzerland(洛桑, 瑞士)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn)
备注: 20 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous “post-mortem” studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.

[NLP-17] Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究在长时间生成过程中，类似于哺乳动物新皮层网络中局部短暂神经沉默（off-states）的时空集中型结构扰动，如何影响自回归大语言模型（LLM）的序列推理能力。其核心问题是：当注意力头的掩码操作以集中爆发式（burst）而非均匀分布（diffuse i.i.d. dropout）的方式施加时，模型推理性能是否会显著下降？解决方案的关键在于通过对比不同扰动模式——即在相同总扰动预算下，集中式的注意力头掩码爆发与分散式的独立同分布随机丢弃——揭示出模型对结构扰动的空间聚集性具有高度敏感性。实验结果表明，集中式扰动导致显著推理退化（如Qwen3-8B准确率从91.2%降至78.8%，Δ = -12.4 pp），而同等预算下的分散扰动则几乎不造成性能损失，凸显了自回归推理链对局部结构破坏的脆弱性，为变压器架构的容错能力提供了关键实证基准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14209
作者: Karol Struniawski
机构: Warsaw University of Life Sciences – SGGW (华沙生命科学大学 – SGGW); Warsaw, Poland
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter \mathcalB=0.10 (scheduling \sim 5.7% of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from 91.2% under diffuse noise to 78.8% under burst dropout ( \Delta = -12.4 percentage points [pp], exact McNemar p = 5.5 \times 10^-6 ), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from 84.0% to 76.8% ( \Delta = -7.2 pp, p = 0.0198 ). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining 91.2% in Qwen and 84.0% in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ( N=100 ), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ( -10.0 pp on Qwen, p_\textholm = 0.0425 ), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ( -7.0 pp, p_\textholm = 0.1892 ). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of -11.4 pp), whereas in LLaMA 22.2% of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to -5.0 pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.

[NLP-18] Representational Atoms in Neural Networks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决神经网络内部表示的组织机制及其与人类概念结构之间关系的刻画问题，核心挑战在于如何形式化定义并有效识别神经网络中具有语义一致性的基本表征单元（Fundamental Representational Units, FRUs）。其解决方案的关键在于提出两个评估标准——保真度（fidelity）与稳定性（stability），并通过理论证明，在适当条件下，阈值激活的稀疏自编码器（Threshold-activated Sparse Autoencoders, TSAEs）能够以高保真度和高稳定性识别出FRUs。大规模实验验证了该方法的有效性，并进一步发现，稳定性更高的FRUs表现出更强的单义性（monosemanticity），且可在不同网络层间进行组合，重构出与人类概念结构相对应的语义组织模式。这一工作构建了一个统一的框架，用于定义、评估与识别神经网络中的基本表征单元，为揭示神经网络表征与人类概念结构之间的关联提供了理论基础与实证支持。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14168
作者: Chenhui Hu,Pengfei Cao,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao
机构: 中国科学院自动化研究所认知与决策智能复杂系统重点实验室; 中国科学院大学人工智能学院
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding the internal representations of neural networks and characterizing their relationship with human conceptual structure are two critical questions for elucidating model mechanisms. The former reveals how learned knowledge is organized in internal representations, whereas the latter provides a basis for interpreting these representations through human conceptual structure. Here, we formally define fundamental representational units (FRUs) and establish two evaluation criteria: fidelity and stability. We further prove that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and validate this result through large-scale experiments. Further analyses reveal that FRUs with higher stability exhibit greater monosemanticity and can be composed across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. These results provide a unified framework for defining, evaluating and identifying FRUs in neural networks, and establish a foundation for characterizing the relationship between neural network representations and human conceptual structure.

[NLP-19] Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在命名扩展任务中，当两个物体共享同一名称时，视觉相似性在多大程度上解释了概念泛化行为，以及教学示例的组成如何补充视觉距离所无法捕捉的信息。其核心问题是：在人类和人工学习者中，视觉相似性（以冻结的自监督视觉编码器DINOv2提取的特征空间距离衡量）是否足以解释词义泛化模式，以及教学示例的类别层级结构（如上位类与下位类）在其中扮演何种作用。解决方案的关键在于通过量化测试图像与教学示例之间的视觉距离，并结合示例的类别层级构成进行分析。研究发现，视觉距离显著预测了人类和人工学习者的泛化倾向（log odds = -3.23/标准差），且在控制分类层级与教学条件后仍具统计效力；更重要的是，示例的类别层级结构对泛化范围具有决定性影响——当教学示例为下位类时，泛化仅覆盖1.1%的上位类对象，而当示例为上位类时，泛化率高达77.5%。此外，尽管视觉编码器的距离与人类感知相似性和混淆度高度相关（rho = .501–.795），但这些距离并不能充分预测学习难度，尤其在个体差异层面，表明人类认知机制中存在超越纯视觉相似性的结构性因素。因此，该研究揭示了视觉相似性与示例组成共同塑造概念泛化的双重机制，其中示例的层级结构提供了视觉距离之外的关键信息。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14116
作者: Patricio M. Vera
机构: Neurocreaciones
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: 15 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL . Data: this https URL and this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis Frank, 2018), computing each test image’s distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2). Distance was associated with extension (log odds -3.23 per standard deviation; 520 people), and an exploratory post hoc analysis suggested that this association persisted within the taught domain after controlling for taxonomic level and teaching condition. Example composition also mattered: after three examples, adults extended a word to 1.1% of superordinate items when the examples were subordinate and to 77.5% when they were superordinate. Second, in an artificial learner using the same encoder, words joining two categories were learned less accurately the farther apart the categories were (84.7%, 65.4%, and 53.0% naming accuracy for near, mid, and far pairs). The encoder’s distances correlated with human similarity and confusability measures from three datasets (rho = .501-.795), but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty, and a second encoder trained on one child’s experience reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect. The secondary human data were analyzed under an internal plan fixed before the confirmatory analyses (not externally preregistered). Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.

[NLP-20] Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决图像条件下的视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）响应中字符级幻觉片段（character-level hallucination span）的检测问题，尤其关注多语言环境（英语、法语、意大利语和中文）下的泛化能力。其核心挑战在于：由于采用因果解码器结构的主干模型（如Gemma-4-12B-it）在生成过程中仅能单向建模上下文，导致对答案中每个位置的隐藏状态缺乏双向上下文感知，从而影响幻觉定位精度。解决方案的关键创新在于——在提示（prompt）中重复候选答案，并从其第二次出现的位置提取隐藏状态，以此在非自回归的一次前向传播中近似实现双向上下文建模。在此基础上，设计了一个字符级定位器（character-level locator），通过融合中间隐藏状态，联合预测幻觉概率、BIO边界以及响应级别的拒答分数；同时引入语言特定分类器，对每个幻觉片段进行五类幻觉类型的判别。实验表明，该方法在闭测试集上实现了0.4404的宏平均字符级交并比（IoU），显著优于官方基线（0.1854），并在四语言任务中位列第5–6名。消融实验进一步验证了重复答案策略与LoRA适配器均对性能提升具有相当贡献，且系统高度依赖图像与答案的配对关系，随机打乱图像会导致性能降至“不预测”基准甚至更低。此外，该框架可复用生成模型的原始权重，无需额外独立验证器，在本地问答系统部署中具备实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14100
作者: Mikhail Kulakov(Novosibirsk State University),Ruslan Solikhov(Novosibirsk State University),Ivan Bondarenko(Novosibirsk State University)
机构: Novosibirsk State University (Новосибирский государственный университет)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 7 pages, 3 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026), Budapest, Hungary. Presented as a poster at the workshop

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.

[NLP-21] HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在无网络信号且缺乏急救人员的紧急情况下，如何利用手机端小型语言模型（Small Language Model, SLMM）提供安全、准确的急救指导这一关键问题。其核心挑战在于，在资源受限环境下，如何确保生成式AI（Generative AI）在无互联网支持时仍能输出符合医学规范、具备高安全性的可靠建议。解决方案的关键在于构建并优化一个轻量化、可离线运行的4-bit量化微调模型——HandsOnAid，基于Gemma 2B架构，采用QLoRA方法在包含5,550个问答对的FirstAidQA数据集上进行微调，并引入检索增强机制以弥补训练数据中对ANZCOR指南关键细节覆盖不足的问题。实验表明，最佳配置（4-bit微调+检索）在严格评估体系下达到2.51/5的平均得分，显著优于基础模型（2.34），且在实际设备（Pixel 7 Pro）上实现了6.86秒内首屏响应、14.88秒内完成完整回答的低延迟表现，验证了其在真实应急场景中的可行性与实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14059
作者: Rezwan Islam Salvi,Saiyma Sittul Muna,Mushfiqur Rahman Mushfique
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 12 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges’ average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.

[NLP-22] MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决巴西葡萄牙语中针对女性的网络仇恨言论（misogyny）缺乏公开、可审计资源的问题。其核心解决方案是构建并发布MISO-BR，一个包含896条平衡标注的社会媒体文本语料库，涵盖二元分类的性别歧视标签。关键创新在于采用可复现的构建流程：结合基于词典和目标导向的X平台爬取、来自已有的大型语言模型预筛选阶段（基于释放的提示与解码参数）的数据，以及三位标注员依据书面指南进行的人工标注，确保了整个数据生产管道的透明性与可审计性。通过多模型对比实验发现，传统分类器在宏平均F1分数上表现介于0.651至0.676之间，偏向精确率但召回率较低；而微调后的BERTimbau Base与Large模型分别达到0.833的宏平均F1与准确率（95%置信区间[0.77, 0.88]），性能差距约16个百分点，且二者在测试集上无显著差异，尽管训练成本相差2.6倍。研究强调，该资源的核心价值不在于指标本身，而在于其完整可追溯的构建流程。同时指出三项重要局限：人为的类别平衡对真实场景下精确率的影响、来源与标签之间的关联性可通过释放的源字段进行测量，以及基于词典引导采样和自动筛选带来的选择偏差。所有语料、标注指南、模型及实验脚本均已开源。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14036
作者: Fábio A.S. Passos,Péricles B.C. Miranda,Ana Paula Cavalcanti
机构: CESAR School; UFRPE(联邦伯南布哥州大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss’ kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.

[NLP-23] Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）智能体在执行复杂交互任务时，其技能（Agent Skills）难以高效维护与演进的问题。现有方法虽通过从智能体执行轨迹中提炼可复用经验并基于下游任务反馈进行技能优化，但普遍将技能表示为自然语言文档，导致过程逻辑与描述性知识混杂，降低了技能的可编辑性和可演化性。为此，本文提出程序增强型可修补技能演化框架（PASE, Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution），其核心在于将可复用的程序化逻辑从自然语言描述中分离，并以可执行程序的形式进行封装。这一设计使得技能的更新聚焦于可修改的程序组件，显著减少对自然语言技能文本的重复修订需求，从而提升技能演化的效率与稳定性。实验结果表明，PASE在多种模型与基准测试中均显著优于现有基线方法，性能提升超过2.8%，且展现出更强的演化稳定性和泛化能力，验证了程序化知识在技能演化中的关键作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14019
作者: Jiahao Wang,Yuqi Xiong,Qing Yang,Zhipeng Xu,Zhenghao Liu,Zulong Chen,Yubin Bao
机构: Northeastern University(东北大学); Alibaba Group(阿里巴巴集团)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 17 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agent skills have emerged as an effective means of enabling LLM agents to solve complex, interactive tasks by encoding reusable knowledge without modifying model parameters. Recent approaches further improve skill adaptation by distilling reusable experience from agent execution trajectories and evolving skills based on downstream task feedback. However, existing methods primarily represent skills as natural language documents, intertwining procedural logic with descriptive knowledge and making skills difficult to maintain and evolve. To address this limitation, we propose PASE (Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution), a program-aided framework that iteratively evolves skills by associating them with executable programs. Unlike prior approaches that encode trajectory-derived experience primarily in natural language, PASE separates reusable procedural logic into editable programs, enabling targeted updates to executable components while reducing the need to repeatedly revise natural language skills. Extensive experiments across diverse models and benchmarks demonstrate that PASE consistently outperforms all baselines, by achieving over 2.8% improvements. Further analyses show that PASE exhibits greater evolutionary stability and generalisation capability, highlighting the critical role of programmatic knowledge in skill evolution. We will release all data and code via GitHub.

[NLP-24] One Sequence Is Enough: Fingerprinting Language Models from Fixed-Length Integer Sequences

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决模型身份伪造问题，即用户通过API或第三方平台请求服务时，所接收到的实际模型可能与其声明的模型不一致，导致信任危机。为应对这一问题，论文提出基于可观察输出进行模型身份验证的方法，核心在于识别生成式AI（Generative AI）在特定任务中隐含的、可区分的行为模式。其解决方案的关键是构建一个名为NumPrint的基准数据集，包含51个模型在中、日、英三种语言提示下生成的共计5,036条固定长度整数序列（每条序列包含294个1至355之间的整数），用于捕捉模型在数值选择任务中的细微偏好差异。研究进一步提出浅层多层感知机与因果变换器（Shallow MLP and Causal Transformer, SMCT）联合架构，以有效建模生成序列中的聚合数值偏好与行为模式。实验结果表明，在51类闭集分类任务中，仅使用单个整数序列，SMCT即可达到92.72%的识别准确率，显著优于现有方法；当使用两个和四个响应序列时，准确率分别提升至96.06%和97.12%，证明单一整数序列已蕴含丰富的模型指纹信息，且多轮输出可进一步增强识别性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14010
作者: Fantong Meng,Chengjie Sun,Shuangjia Yang,Zhiyuan Zhao,Yansheng Pei,Xinyang Li
机构: Harbin Institute of Technology (哈尔滨工业大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages including appendices, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Users of model APIs and third-party platforms often rely on the declared model name to identify the model responding to their requests. However, the actual model may differ from the declared one, motivating identity verification based on observable outputs. Previous studies have shown that preferences in simple numerical-choice tasks can serve as model fingerprints. We investigate whether a single fixed-length integer sequence can combine multiple numerical observations to identify its source model. For this task, we introduce NumPrint, a benchmark of 5,036 answers from 51 models, collected using Chinese, Japanese, and English prompts that request 294 integers between 1 and 355 in one response. We propose the Shallow MLP and Causal Transformer (SMCT) to capture aggregate numerical preferences and behavioral patterns in generated sequences. In 51-class closed-set evaluation, SMCT achieves 92.72% accuracy from a single sequence, outperforming all methods compared in this study. Using two and four answers increases accuracy to 96.06% and 97.12%, respectively. These results show that a single integer sequence contains useful model fingerprints and that additional answers further improve identification.

[NLP-25] Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型代理在处理长时程任务时面临的记忆管理难题，即当交互历史超过模型的上下文窗口限制时，如何有效决定哪些信息应被记录、何时读取以及如何利用外部存储进行记忆维护。现有方法通过在策略中引入基于策略的蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD），将记忆控制纳入策略学习框架，但依赖于预训练阶段未涵盖的记忆工具与压缩协议，导致教师模型无法提供有效指导，学生模型也难以充分学习有意义的记忆操作行为。其解决方案的关键在于提出Coding Agent Memory Gym II（CAMG-II）这一多场景长时程智能体强化学习环境套件，涵盖购物、编码、自动研究、通用任务及视觉任务，并为每个环境提供标准Bash访问和跨回合持久化工作区，使智能体能够以文件形式创建、修改、搜索和复用记忆；同时引入Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II（CAMP-II），采用完全异步的OPD机制，在冻结教师模型的先验指导下，联合训练单一策略以直接学习基于文件的记忆行为。实验表明，CAMP-II在CAMG-II上相较最强基准提升2.97倍，且所学记忆行为可泛化至Terminal-Bench 2.1和SWE-Bench Pro V2两个外部基准，显著提高成功率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14009
作者: Lirui Luo,Kelong Mao,Xinwei Yang,Rongqing Li,Luyu Chen,Kieran Wong,Yudong Guo,Xinrui Wang,Jiayin Zhu,Gu Simiu,Sulong Xu,Cong Fang
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 40 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model’s active context. They must therefore decide what to write down and what to read back, and when to do either. Recent work has begun to use on-policy distillation (OPD) to make memory control part of the policy, relying on memory tools and compaction protocols that lie outside either model’s pre-training. However, this weakens the distillation on both sides: the teacher cannot give useful guidance on an interface it has never used, and the student samples too few meaningful memory actions for that guidance to take effect. To study this problem, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym II (CAMG-II), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, AutoResearch, General, and Visual. Alongside each environment’s native task interface, CAMG-II provides ordinary Bash access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling the policy to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory across context replacements. We also introduce Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II (CAMP-II), which trains a single policy jointly across all five environments with fully asynchronous OPD to learn this file-based memory behavior directly from a frozen teacher with a prior for file operations. On CAMG-II, CAMP-II obtains 2.97 times the gain of the strongest OPD baseline. The memory behavior CAMP-II learns generalizes to two external benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, with improved success rates.

[NLP-26] Specify Privacy Yourself: Assessing Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Preservation Ability of Large Vision-Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大型视觉语言模型（Large Vision-Language Models, LVLMs）在图像中高精度推断敏感个人信息所带来的隐私泄露问题，尤其针对现有模型在通用隐私保护（如信用卡信息）方面虽表现良好，但对个性化、上下文依赖的隐私需求缺乏有效应对能力。其核心挑战在于如何实现推理时的个性化隐私保护（Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Protection, ITP³），即允许用户通过自然语言指令动态定义隐私边界。解决方案的关键在于提出首个系统性评估框架SPY-Bench，包含32,700个涵盖67类隐私场景与24种真实情境的图像-问题对及个性化隐私指令，并设计基于用户意图与上下文感知的新颖评估指标。实验表明，当前21个主流LVLM在ITP³任务上的平均合规准确率仅为约24%，且普遍缺乏上下文隐私理解能力。为此，研究进一步引入一种改进的噪声对比对齐（Noise Contrastive Alignment）方法，在保持合理泛化性能的同时，将合规准确率提升至96.88%，标志着迈向可控制、伦理化部署更智能视觉语言模型的重要进展。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13997
作者: Xingqi Wang,Xiaoyuan Yi,Xing Xie,Jia Jia
机构: Tsinghua University (清华大学); Microsoft Research Asia (微软亚洲研究院)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2025 (Brave New Ideas track)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but raise significant privacy concerns due to their abilities to infer sensitive personal information from images with high precision. While current LVLMs are relatively well aligned to protect universal privacy, e.g., credit card data, we argue that privacy is inherently personalized and context-dependent. This work pivots towards a novel task: can LVLMs achieve Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Protection (ITP ^3 ), allowing users to dynamically specify privacy boundaries through language specifications? To this end, we present SPY-Bench, the first systematic assessment of ITP ^3 ability, which comprises (1) 32,700 unique samples with image-question pairs and personalized privacy instructions across 67 categories and 24 real-world scenarios, and (2) novel metrics grounded in user specifications and context awareness. Benchmarking the ITP ^3 ability of 21 SOTA LVLMs, we reveal that: (i) most models, even the top-performing o4-mini, perform poorly, with only \sim 24% compliance accuracy; (ii) they show quite limited contextual privacy understanding capability. Therefore, we implemented initial ITP ^3 alignment methods, including a novel Noise Contrastive Alignment variant which achieves 96.88% accuracy while maintaining reasonable general performance. These results mark an initial step towards the ethical deployment of more controllable LVLMs. Code and data are available at this https URL

[NLP-27] On the information rate of phones syllables and words

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语音内容编码所需比特率最小化的语言单元选择问题，即在音素（phone）、音节（syllable）、词（word）、多词组合及更大或中间尺度的语义单元中，哪类单位能实现最优的信息压缩效率。这一问题对语音与语言系统的设计以及人类语言处理机制的理论构建具有重要意义。研究基于960小时英语有声书的转写语料库，对比了音素、音节、词、多词短语及中间粒度分词方案下的信息速率（information rate）。尽管在理想语言模型下所有单位表现等价，但在实际建模能力受限的情况下，需权衡不同单位的表现；因此，研究采用n-gram与Transformer语言模型进行评估。结果表明，在建模资源有限时，以词为单位的编码可实现最低比特率，而略大于词的单位（如短语）有时表现更优。核心结论是：当建模容量受限时，比音节大但远小于长距离多词短语的中等粒度单元（intermediate units），在信息速率方面提供了最高效的表示方式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13990
作者: Herman Kamper
机构: Stellenbosch University (斯蒂伦博斯大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: 5 pages, 1 table, 2 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Which linguistic units minimise the bitrate required to encode speech content: phones, syllables, words, maybe larger units, or something in between? This question has implications for the development of speech and language systems and theories of human language processing. Using a transcribed corpus of 960 hours of English audiobooks, I compare the information rates of phones, syllables, words, multi-word combinations and intermediate tokenisations. While all units are equivalent under a perfect language model, it makes sense to compare these under limited modelling budgets; I use n -gram and transformer language models. The lowest bitrates are achieved using words, with slightly longer units sometimes performing best. The results show that, when modelling capacity is limited, units larger than syllables but smaller than long multi-word phrases provide the most efficient representation in terms of information rate.

[NLP-28] Understanding Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Beyond Expert Boundaries

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决混合专家模型（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）中专家专业化本质的争议问题，即领域特异性专家偏好与基于标记身份或句法模式的路由机制之间的矛盾。其核心挑战在于：现有研究在专家层级上难以统一解释路由行为的驱动因素，而本文通过突破传统专家层面的分析范式，转而从神经元层级揭示领域专用计算的组织结构。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为“路由感知幅度剖析”（Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling, RAMP）的新方法，用于识别具有领域特异性的神经元集合，并追踪其在预训练与后训练阶段的重要性演化。研究发现，尽管专家层级的重要性排名相对稳定，但神经元层级的重要性仍持续重组，表明领域专业化在神经元层面具有动态演化特性。基于此，进一步提出基于RAMP的剪枝方法（RAMPr），通过选择跨专家的代表性神经元，在保持多领域能力均衡的前提下实现高效压缩。实验表明，在保留75%神经元时，模型平均性能损失仅为2%-9%；在50%保留率下，可降低36%-43%的驻留GPU内存占用，并提升批处理预填充吞吐量17%-39%，显著优化了MoE模型的效率与可扩展性。

作者: Zhenhong Zhou,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Qiankun Li,Kun Wang,Junfeng Fang
机构: Nanyang Technological University (南洋理工大学); Tencent(腾讯); National University of Singapore (新加坡国立大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, the nature of expert specialization remains controversial. Reports of domain-associated expert preferences contrast with analyses attributing routing primarily to token identity or syntactic patterns. To clarify these differing accounts, we look beyond expert-level routing to investigate the neuron-level organization of domain-specialized computation using Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP), a measure developed for this analysis. Using mixed-domain calibration data, we identify domain-specialized neuron sets with 58-74% overlap across multi-source samples of the same domain, compared with 15-24% across domains. To understand how this organization evolves during training, we trace neuron importance throughout pre-training and post-training across three fully open MoE families. Neuron importance continues to reorganize between pre-training checkpoints despite comparatively stable expert-level importance rankings, while post-training largely preserves neuron rankings. Building on these neuron-level perspectives, we further introduce RAMP-based Pruning (RAMPr) to select neurons across experts for balanced multi-domain capability preservation. At 75% neuron retention, RAMPr preserves average 91-98% of original full performance across six models. At 50% retention, our pruning method can reduce resident GPU memory by 36-43% and improves batched prefill throughput by 17-39% effectively. Our code is available at this https URL

[NLP-29] Beyond Fluent Responses: Finding User Dissatisfaction in Human-AI Interactions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统大语言模型响应评估中过度依赖响应本身质量（如正确性与连贯性）而忽视用户中心评价指标的问题，即如何有效捕捉真实对话中用户的主观满意度与感知有用性。其核心挑战在于，用户实际的满意程度往往不完全反映在生成响应的质量上，而是隐含于对话文本中的细微语用线索。论文的关键解决方案是通过分析带有自我报告不满标签的用户话语，探索从对话文本中检测隐性不满信号的可能性。研究发现，在英文对话场景下，仅基于用户自身话语构建的模型即可在AUPRC指标上超出17.8%的基准不满率达15个百分点，表明用户话语中蕴含可被识别的不满线索；进一步研究表明，结合前一回合用户话语的变化特征，尤其是采用异常检测方法，能显著提升不满识别效果，凸显了动态语境变化在用户情绪感知中的关键作用。

Abstract:As large language models generate increasingly high-quality responses, recent work on response evaluation has moved beyond response-centered criteria, such as correctness and coherence, toward user-centered criteria, including user preferences and perceived usefulness. This shift is fundamentally important for developing technologies that are truly useful to real-world users. While conventional response evaluation quantifies the quality of the response itself, users’ satisfaction in real conversations also depends on their subjective preferences and perceptions of usefulness, which do not necessarily align with response quality. This study investigates whether such user-centered signals can be detected from conversational text. Specifically, we analyze user utterances with self-reported dissatisfaction labels to examine whether user dissatisfaction in text can be detected. In English interaction, models using user utterances exceeded the 17.8% dissatisfaction label prevalence in AUPRC by up to 15 percentage points. These results suggest that user utterances reveal cues to implicit dissatisfaction. Furthermore, changes from the immediately preceding user utterance may improve dissatisfaction detection, with anomaly detection methods appearing particularly effective.

[NLP-30] Are Causal Neuron Circuits Unique and Transferable?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型中神经元群干预实验的可解释性局限问题，即现有方法仅能证明某组神经元对模型输出具有影响，却无法确定其必要性、可替代性及泛化能力。核心问题是：当干预一组神经元会改变模型答案时，究竟需要多少该组神经元才是关键？其解决方案的关键在于系统性地评估神经元组内所有可能的子集（共4,096个12神经元子集）在不同任务中的因果效应。研究发现，在双选项首都识别任务中，尽管零消融特定12个神经元会使答案置信度下降27%，但这些神经元的激活值在不同问题间近乎恒定，缺乏问题特异性内容；而在两跳关系链任务中，用第一跳问题的激活值“替换”12个神经元即可将答案导向桥接实体（如从“Scar”变为“Simba”），且该效果在多数链路中成立（9/11、9/11、8/10），而随机神经元则无此效应。进一步分析表明，完整神经元组通常非必需，少数神经元即可引发答案切换，且多个不相交子集独立具备翻转答案的能力，尤其在模型置信度较低时更常见。此外，这种干预效应可迁移至同一链路的重述版本，但在其他链路上显著减弱。研究强调了神经元层面因果干预与子集探索的重要性，但未重建完整神经电路的连接结构。

Abstract:Interpretability demonstrations often show that intervening on a group of neurons changes a model’s answer. A recent example removes an 18-neuron group in Qwen3-32B and the model answers “Simba” instead of “Scar” to a two-hop Lion King riddle. Such a demonstration establishes that the group matters, but not how much of it is necessary, whether other groups could do the same, or whether the effect carries over to other inputs. We ask: when intervening on a group of neurons changes a model’s answer, how much of that group is actually necessary? For every selected group we measure all 4,096 subsets of 12 MLP neurons. On a two-alternative capital task (Qwen3-0.6B), zero-ablating 12 selected neurons lowers the answer margin by 27% while random neurons barely change it, yet replacing the same neurons with their values from other questions also barely changes it: their activations are nearly constant across questions, and we find no evidence that they carry question-specific content. On two-hop relation chains, patching 12 neurons with activations from the first-hop question shifts the answer to the bridge entity (from Scar to Simba): the greedy answer starts with the bridge in 9/11 chains for Qwen3-1.7B, 9/11 for Llama-3.2-1B and 8/10 for Gemma-3-1B; random neurons never do. The full group is rarely necessary: a few neurons often suffice, and in many chains disjoint subsets each flip the answer on their own, in an exploratory analysis most often when the model is less confident. Group effects transfer to rephrasings of the same chain but are much weaker on other tested chains. We study neuron-level causal interventions and alternative subsets; we do not recover the full connectivity of circuits.

[NLP-31] Beyond Passive Imitation: On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation for Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决持续预训练（Continual Pre-Training, CPT）中标准的下一个词预测（Next-Token Prediction, NTP）目标所导致的训练-生成不匹配问题。传统NTP方法将所有语料库中的词元视为固定目标，忽视了其对当前模型的实际价值，导致相同训练序列在不同基础模型上产生截然不同的效果——例如，在相同10亿词的数学语料上，NTP能提升Llama-3.2-3B的表现，却显著损害Qwen3-1.7B-Base的性能，暴露出模型依赖性与训练目标僵化的问题。为此，论文提出基于策略的中期蒸馏（On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation, OPMD），其核心创新在于将中段训练从静态的离线文本模仿转变为动态、查询驱动的知识获取过程。OPMD在选定锚点位置采样自学生策略的轨迹，并利用冻结教师模型提供的密集词元级反KL奖励进行训练，使模型学习其实际访问的状态，而非仅基于真实前缀的监督信号。这一在策略（on-policy）目标有效缓解了教师强制式NTP带来的训练-生成偏差。实验表明，OPMD在MATH-500和Minerva基准上均优于原始基线，尤其显著提升了Qwen模型的表现，且无需额外推理开销，为持续预训练提供了一种具备模型感知能力的主动领域适应方案。

Abstract:Continual pre-training (CPT) adapts large language models (LLMs) to specialized domains, yet its standard next-token prediction (NTP) objective treats every corpus token as a fixed target, regardless of its utility to the current model. In a controlled study on the same 1B-token mathematical corpus, we observe sharply different outcomes across base models: NTP improves Llama-3.2-3B’s performance on mathematical benchmarks but substantially degrades Qwen3-1.7B-Base’s performance, indicating that, under a fixed training recipe, the same training sequences can have model-dependent effects. To address this problem, we introduce On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation (OPMD), which reformulates mid-training from offline text imitation into active, query-driven knowledge acquisition. At selected anchor positions, OPMD samples trajectories from the evolving student policy and applies dense token-level reverse-KL rewards from a frozen teacher, training the model on states it actually visits rather than only on ground-truth prefixes. This on-policy objective reduces the training-generation mismatch of teacher-forced NTP. On MATH-500 and Minerva, OPMD improves the Qwen student over its base performance and outperforms the evaluated NTP baseline, which degrades on both benchmarks. OPMD integrates into CPT pipelines without added inference-time overhead and offers a model-aware alternative to passive domain adaptation.

[NLP-32] Alania-2: Turkish text-to-speech with instant and fine-tuned voice cloning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决土耳其语文本转语音（TTS）系统在语音自然度、可懂度及个性化语音克隆方面的关键挑战，尤其针对合成语音中数字、缩写和外来词等复杂文本元素处理不当导致的语义丢失问题。其核心解决方案是提出Alania-2——一个基于VoxCPM架构的488M参数模型，采用语言模型骨干网络结合扩散头生成连续音频潜在表示，并通过18,195小时土耳其语语音数据进行端到端训练，其中90%为由更大教师模型生成并自动筛选的合成语音。关键创新包括：引入文本规范化模块，将数字、缩写和外文名称转换为符合土耳其语发音习惯的词语表达，显著提升合成语音的可懂性（无此模块时96个测试句中仅86%完整保留关键信息）；通过高质量训练数据实现小模型高可懂度，表明数据质量对语音清晰度的影响大于模型规模；在语音克隆方面，仅以参考音频作为条件而非延续其内容，可将漏词率从21.9%降至1.7%，且20–30秒参考音频效果最佳，配合低秩适配器可在约两分钟内实现优于即时克隆的说话人相似度；此外，优化推理引擎使首个音频输出延迟降低至32毫秒，显著提升实时性。研究还公开了评估工具链与三个土耳其语语音与文本数据集，推动领域发展。

Abstract:We present Alania-2, a Turkish text-to-speech (TTS) system with two built-in voices, voice design from text descriptions, and two kinds of voice cloning. Alania-2 is a 488M-parameter model with the VoxCPM architecture, which generates continuous audio latents with a diffusion head on top of a language-model backbone. We train it from scratch on 18,195 hours of Turkish speech, 90% of which is synthetic speech produced by a larger teacher model and filtered automatically. A text normalizer rewrites numbers, abbreviations and foreign names into the words a Turkish speaker would say; without it, none of 96 test sentences with digits kept all its critical parts, such as an amount or a date, through synthesis and speech recognition, against 86 with it. On Freya-TR-Eval, a public benchmark of 495 Turkish sentences scored with automatic speech recognition, Alania-2 reaches a word error rate of 1.44%, compared with 5.99% for our previous system. On its built-in voices, it comes within half a point of character error rate of a 2.3B-parameter model at under a quarter of the size, and a 7.6M-parameter single-voice model trained with the same recipe matches the most intelligible systems we measured, which suggests that training data matters more for intelligibility than model size. We also report practical findings on voice cloning: conditioning on the reference audio alone, rather than continuing it, cuts skipped words from 21.9% to 1.7%; 20-30 seconds of reference audio works best; and a low-rank adapter trained in about two minutes raises speaker similarity well above instant cloning. Finally, we describe inference-engine changes that bring first audio down to 32 ms for a single stream. We release our evaluation harness and three Turkish speech and text datasets.

[NLP-33] PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing with Baselines and a Leaderboard

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言环境下生成式决策编码器（Typed-decision encoders）在非英语场景下的行为评估缺乏统一基准的问题。现有方法通常仅在英语上进行验证，导致跨语言性能难以客观衡量。为此，作者发布了PolyRoute数据集，包含322条涵盖12种语言和9种文字系统的原生语言消息、156条混合语或罗马化文本（如Hinglish、Spanglish、Arabizi），以及967条可选的本地化训练样本，并设计了一个三向部门路由决策任务的标准化评估协议。所有标签均由Qwen3.8-27B模型生成，并通过盲测第二轮验证（保留91%候选项），独立模型gemma4-31b在测试集上达成97.2%的一致性，且任意测试文本与训练文本之间的最大字符5-gram相似度仅为0.33，表明数据具有足够的多样性与挑战性。实验结果显示，基于该基准的13个系统中，以英语为根的检查点得分为61.2%，多语言预训练模型达到77.3%，最优微调模型则高达96.6%；而TF-IDF结合逻辑回归方法亦达91.9%。在四个保留语言上的表现分别为77%、90%和93%，验证了模型的泛化能力。此外，在混合语文本上，英语根模型（85%）虽略优于多语言预训练模型（79%；p=0.134），但两者差异仅在性能提升超过约4个百分点时才显著。该研究的关键在于构建了一个高质量、多样化且严格控制的多语言评估基准，推动了生成式决策编码器在真实世界复杂语言环境中的可比性与可复现性研究。

Abstract:Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick. We release PolyRoute: 322 native-language support messages in 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows, and a protocol for a three-way department-routing decision. Labels come from Qwen3.8-27B with a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept); an independent model, gemma4-31b, agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the largest character 5-gram similarity between any test text and any training text is 0.33. A leaderboard of 13 systems gives 61.2% for the English-root checkpoint, 77.3% for the shipped multilingual one and 96.6% for the best fine-tune; TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9%. On four withheld languages the three multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. On code-mixed text the English root (85%) is nominally ahead of the shipped multilingual checkpoint (79%; p=0.134). The split resolves differences only above about 4 points. All texts and labels are LLM-generated.

[NLP-34] Antalia-2 Mini: A 7.6-million-parameter Turkish text-to-speech model trained entirely on synthetic speech

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言（土耳其语）下高质量文本到语音（TTS）合成的挑战，特别是如何在有限训练数据和计算资源条件下实现高保真、低错误率的语音生成。其核心问题在于：如何利用大规模预训练教师模型（VoxCPM2）的知识进行高效迁移，以训练出参数量仅为760万的轻量化学生模型（Antalia-2 Mini），同时保持接近工业级的语音质量与自动语音识别（ASR）准确率。解决方案的关键在于采用“知识蒸馏”策略，即通过教师模型生成合成音频并进行自动质量筛选，仅保留约1,790小时高质量语音用于学生模型训练；此外，通过对声码器（vocoder）在学生模型自身生成的梅尔频谱图上进行微调，显著降低了Whisper语音识别系统的词错误率（WER）——从3.89%降至1.75%。值得注意的是，尽管学生模型在设计上模仿了教师模型的缺陷（如以“ö”开头的音节起始失真），但通过输出前缀截断的方式有效规避了该问题。在公开的Freya-TR-Eval基准测试中，版本1.0.1达到WER 1.09%与字符错误率0.22%，性能可与参数量更大的860万参数模型EMA Lightning相媲美，且在全带宽UTMOS（一种基于英语训练的质量评估代理指标）上表现更优。研究强调了模型轻量化与高质量之间的平衡，其权重、推理代码及评测框架已开源（Apache-2.0），但训练代码与数据未公开。

Abstract:Antalia-2 Mini is a single-voice Turkish text-to-speech model with 7,620,931 parameters. It reads characters and produces 48 kHz audio at 41 times real time on an Apple M5 laptop CPU (2 threads). Its training audio came only from VoxCPM2 (the teacher), about 300 times larger, cloning one synthetic clip; automatic checks kept about 1,790 h. Fine-tuning the vocoder on the acoustic model’s own mel spectrograms cut the word error rate (WER) of Whisper’s transcripts from a mean of 3.89% to 1.75% at adjacent pre-release checkpoints. The teacher corrupts the start of a clip when the first word begins with ö, the student learned this, and a spoken prefix we cut from the output hides it. On the 495-sentence Freya-TR-Eval benchmark, where we tuned settings, version 1.0.1 has WER 1.09% and character error rate 0.22% on our public harness. A paired bootstrap cannot distinguish these from EMA Lightning, an 8.6M Turkish model, which scores higher on full-band UTMOS, an English-trained quality proxy. No human listening test exists. Weights, inference code and the benchmark harness are public under Apache-2.0; training code and data are not.

[NLP-35] LLM Validation Makes Minimal-Pair Benchmarks Easier for Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决最小对（minimal-pair）基准测试中标签质量依赖人工标注成本过高的问题，提出以大语言模型（LLM）替代高成本的人工验证。其解决方案的关键在于利用多类LLM（强制选择、评分及集体判断）进行自动化验证，并通过与不同规模人类评审团（1、3、5名裁判）的对比评估其有效性。研究发现，在BLiMP和QFrBLiMP两个数据集上，尽管强制选择型LLM验证者的共识率高于五人评委组，但其识别出的人类拒绝标签的能力远低于单个裁判；从点估计看，任何单一验证者的价值不超过一名人类裁判。更重要的是，错误并非随机分布：在所有70种模型-验证组合中，经预注册的LLM过滤器所标记为“人类支持”的样本比接受样本在难度上平均高出18.9分，且显著高于单个裁判所标记的样本，表明该过滤机制有效剔除了模型表现不佳但人类仍能正确判断的项目，从而提升整体准确性，优于随机删除。此外，冻结协议前的验证流程在荷兰语版BLiMP-NL上复现了相同结果，进一步验证了方法的稳健性。研究揭示，使用LLM进行验证反而使基准测试对目标模型而言更简单，为此作者公开代码、验证输出及项目级得分。

Abstract:Minimal-pair benchmarks are only as good as their labels, and LLMs are an obvious substitute for costly human validation. We test it on BLiMP (English) and QFrBLiMP (Quebec French), the two public minimal-pair datasets releasing every forced-choice human judgment. Three LLMs validate by forced choice, by rating, and as a panel, scored against human panels of one, three and five judges in two pre-registered phases. On BLiMP, forced-choice validators agree with held-out human majorities more often than five-judge panels, yet catch far fewer pairs whose label humans reject than one judge does. By point estimate, no validator is worth more than one judge. The errors are not random. On both datasets, across 10 open LMs, human-supported pairs that the pre-registered LLM filter flags are 18.9 points harder than those it accepts, in all 70 LM-validator combinations, and harder than pairs a single human judge flags. Filtering thus removes items on which LMs fail but humans do not, raising accuracy more than random removal. A protocol frozen before any output replicates the gap and the lift on Dutch BLiMP-NL. LLM validation makes minimal-pair benchmarks easier for the models they are meant to test; we release code, validator outputs and item-level scores.

[NLP-36] Word-Level Alignment of OCR and Ground Truth under Zoning and Reading-Order Errors ICDAR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决光学字符识别（OCR）后处理中词级对齐的“分区问题”（Zoning Problem），即在存在版面错位、文本行顺序错乱等情况下，如何实现OCR输出与真实文本（ground truth）之间准确的词级对齐。传统单调对齐方法在读序被置换时容易丢失匹配位置，导致对齐失败。其解决方案的关键在于引入一种基于构造阶段词级真值（gold）的读序随机置换测试协议，通过在OCR端施加读序变换（如块移动、段落互换、列交错等），评估不同对齐方法在读序扰动下的鲁棒性。核心创新包括：采用唯一词或唯一n-gram作为锚点的多区域对齐策略，结合块到窗口的分配机制，以及对2019年提出的位置感知对齐器进行重锚定扩展。实验结果表明，尽管局部追踪在大位移下仍脆弱，但基于锚点的方法在多数读序变化场景中表现更优，然而当唯一锚点稀缺时仍会失效。此外，研究揭示了现有数据集在真值标注精度、文章排序惯例、残差标注缺失及现代多栏版面词级真值缺乏等方面的局限性，制约了对齐性能的进一步提升。

Abstract:OCR post-processing needs OCR text aligned word by word with its ground truth. Data sets rarely provide that mapping, and a monotone aligner can lose its place when zoning errors permute the reading order. We revisit this problem, the Zoning Problem of our 2019 paper, with a protocol that tests correctness under such permutations. We apply OCR-side reading-order permutations with construction-time word-level gold and score correct-match F1, cascade length and recovery. We compare the 2019 location-aware aligner, a re-anchoring extension of it, a RETAS-style baseline (RETAS-lite), a multi-region aligner that combines unique-word and unique n-gram anchors with chunk-to-window assignment, genalog’s RETAS and the original Java RETAS. Experiments use synthetic character noise with block moves, paragraph swaps and column interleaving, historical newspaper reading-order permutations, geometry-derived gold for Tesseract OCR, and a small word-box set. Synthetic tests show where local tracking fails after large displacements and where unique-anchor methods collapse when unique anchors are scarce. On our synthetic boilerplate page the 2019 method had the highest F1 among those tested. Historical newspaper and geometry-derived evaluations carry the limitations of approximate gold and the article-order convention. The first multi-region version has a quadratic scaling cost. Local tracking remains fragile under large reading-order changes; the tested anchor-based methods handle many of those cases but fail when unique anchors are scarce. Approximate gold, the article-order convention, missing residual annotation, and the lack of modern multi-column word-level ground truth remain limitations.

[NLP-37] Do Language Models Feel the Sentiment? Investigating Emotion Vectors

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型中情感向量（emotion vectors）在情感分类任务中的作用机制不明确的问题，尤其关注其在预训练模型内部表征中的实际贡献与可操作性。研究聚焦于Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct两个模型，通过情感探针（sentiment probing）、激活干预（activation interventions）及监督修正（supervised correction）等方法，系统评估了从GoEmotions数据集中提取的8个情感方向对情感分类性能的影响。关键发现在于：仅使用情感空间的探针即可在二元TweetEval任务上达到88.66%和90.70%的准确率，表明模型内部已编码显著的情感信息；匹配消融实验显示，移除原始情感空间导致的准确率下降幅度显著高于随机子空间移除（分别多出2.39和1.10个百分点），说明情感方向具有非随机且特异性的语义影响；此外，在多个基准测试中，原始与去噪后的情感影响均在经过Holm校正后表现显著，但情感修正分类器在亚马逊极性评论任务上未能持续超越仅依赖边际信息（margin-only）的基线，提示情感向量虽具可识别性，但其直接用于分类优化的效果有限。因此，该研究的关键在于区分了模型表征中蕴含的情感信息、改变这些表征所引发的行为变化及其在实际分类任务中的价值，揭示了情感向量并非唯一决定性机制，而是一种可被利用但需谨慎解释的中间表征成分。

Abstract:Emotion vectors are directions in a language model’s internal representations that are associated with emotional concepts. Prior work shows that these vectors can influence model behavior, but their role in sentiment classification remains unclear. This study investigates emotion directions in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. Eight directions extracted from GoEmotions are evaluated through sentiment probing, activation interventions, and supervised correction. Emotion-only probes achieve 88.66% and 90.70% accuracy on binary TweetEval. In exploratory matched-ablation experiments, raw emotion-space removal causes 2.39 and 1.10 percentage points more accuracy loss than matched isotropic random-subspace removal for 0.5B and 3B, respectively. All four TweetEval raw and denoised effects are significant after Holm adjustment across eight comparisons. An exploratory SST-2 extension shows smaller raw excess losses of 0.66 and 0.57 points, with no effects surviving Holm adjustment. Frozen sentiment-correction classifiers are also tested on 20,000 Amazon Polarity reviews. Emotion-based correction improves accuracy over uncorrected Qwen, but does not consistently outperform margin-only baselines. These results distinguish sentiment information available in model representations, the effects of changing those representations, and their practical value for classification. They do not establish a uniquely emotional mechanism.

[NLP-38] You Are What You Read: Indian Political News Media Bias Dataset for Hindi Language

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决印度语境下，尤其是印地语（Hindi）等印地语族语言中媒体偏见（media bias）的理解与检测这一研究不足的问题。由于印度语言多样性显著且人口庞大，同一事件常由多家新闻机构以不同语言报道，从而引入潜在的偏见风险。为此，本文构建了一个全面、多标注者参与且具备可解释性的数据集，包含来自四家主流印地语新闻机构的448篇独特政治新闻文章。数据集由14名专家进行标注，将文章分类为四种偏见类型：选择性偏见（selection bias）、框架偏见（framing bias）、标题党偏见（clickbait bias）和遗漏偏见（omission bias），并针对每篇被判定为有偏的文章提供文本解释，以支持未来基于语言模型的半自动化方法实现可解释性推理。实验结果显示，简单二分类任务的Cohen’s Kappa值为0.81，多标签任务各偏见类别的Kappa值分别为0.89（标题党）、0.75（选择性）、0.81（框架）和0.79（遗漏），平均Kappa达0.80，表明标注者间具有高度一致性。该研究的关键在于通过高质量、可解释的多专家标注数据集，为印地语媒体偏见检测提供可靠基准，并推动生成式AI在该领域中的可解释性应用。

Abstract:Media bias understanding and detection remains an under-researched problem for Indian context, specifically for Indic languages, such as, Hindi, which is widely spoken in India. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive, multi-annotator, explainable dataset consisting of 448 unique articles from four leading Indian news agencies publishing in Hindi. We focus on Hindi, the most spoken and an official language of India. The study of media bias is particularly relevant in the Indian context due to the country’s linguistic diversity and large population, where the same event is often reported by multiple news agencies in different languages, thereby introducing scope for bias. The dataset comprises Hindi political news articles annotated by 14 experts and classified into four bias categories - selection bias, framing bias, clickbait bias and omission bias - when an article is identified as biased or unbiased. For each biased article, annotators also provide a textual explanation, enabling future semi-automated approaches to incorporate explainability when language models reason over the dataset. Cohen’s Kappa scores were 0.81 for simple bias/no-bias classification reflecting strong inter-annotator agreement. For the multi-label task, the Cohen’s Kappa values are 0.89, 0.75, 0.81, and 0.79 for clickbait, selection, framing, and omission biases, respectively, resulting in an average Kappa of 0.80, which also reflects strong agreement.

[NLP-39] OpticalRAG : Pixel-Space Compression for Token-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）因大语言模型（LLM）上下文窗口令牌预算限制所导致的效率与信息保真度之间的矛盾问题。传统文本压缩方法在降低输入长度时会不可逆地丢失细粒度语义信息，而单纯增加上下文长度又带来计算成本激增。其核心解决方案在于改变信息压缩的模态：提出 OpticalRAG 框架，将文档渲染为页面图像，并利用冻结的视觉编码器以约百个视觉令牌高效编码整页内容，显著提升信息密度且保留丰富语义。该框架的关键创新在于两个无需跨模态训练的组件：(i) 编码器桥接检索（Encoder-Bridged Retrieval），通过共享投影层将文本查询映射至视觉特征空间，实现基于文本查询的视觉令牌检索；(ii) 查询驱动蒸馏（Query-Driven Distillation），采用轻量级交叉注意力机制将检索到的视觉令牌压缩为仅16个与查询相关的前缀令牌。实验表明，OpticalRAG 在 LongBench-v2、BAMBOO 与 LooGLE-v2 基准上均实现了最优的压缩感知准确率（Compression-Aware Accuracy, CAP），同时仅注入16个令牌，显著提升了闭卷版 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的性能（提升5.17点）。

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is bottlenecked by the token budget of large language models: feeding long documents into the context window is expensive, while aggressive textual compression discards fine-grained information that is irreversibly lost in a one-dimensional token sequence. We argue that this bottleneck is not fundamental to information density but to the choice of compression \emphmodality. Modern visual encoders can pack the contents of a rendered text page into roughly a hundred visual tokens with little semantic loss, opening a new compression-fidelity tradeoff that purely textual methods cannot reach. We present \textbfOpticalRAG, a framework that renders documents as page images, encodes them with a frozen vision encoder, and distills the retrieved visual tokens into as few as 16 injected tokens before passing them to the LLM. Two ingredients make this work without expensive cross-modal training: (i) \emphEncoder-Bridged Retrieval, which projects text-query states into the visual feature space of the frozen encoder, through a projection shared with the compressor, to retrieve visual tokens from a text query, with no contrastive training; and (ii) \emphQuery-Driven Distillation, a lightweight cross-attention compressor that condenses the retrieved visual tokens into a small set of query-conditioned prefix tokens. On LongBench-v2, BAMBOO, and LooGLE-v2, OpticalRAG achieves the best compression-aware accuracy (CAP) on all three benchmarks while injecting only 16 tokens, and improves the closed-book Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by 5.17 points on this http URL is available at this https URL.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决早期汉译佛典的作者归属问题，即在缺乏明确历史记载的情况下，如何通过文本风格特征准确判定译者身份。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个可解释的风格计量（stylometric）分析框架，该框架整合了佛教文献学专家定义或验证的语言学特征，包括虚词使用、句式结构、句末字类型、句子长度以及词性n元组等。研究基于东汉至西晋七位译者的31部确证译作建立风格谱系模型，并将8篇存在争议的文本与安世高（An Shigao）的风格谱系进行比对。结果显示，T1557和T0101两篇文本与安世高已确认译作的风格相似度最高（分别为0.783和0.687），其归属判断与基于BERT的已有研究结果一致。该方法无需特定任务的训练过程，且具备高度可解释性，使学者能够追溯支持每项归因的具体语言特征，从而提升文本归属判断的科学性与可信度。

Abstract:Attributing early Chinese Buddhist translations requires evidence that scholars can trace back to the texts. We develop an interpretable stylometric framework that uses features defined or reviewed by Buddhist philologists, including function characters, sentence formulas, sentence-final characters, sentence length, and part-of-speech n-grams. We construct stylistic profiles from 31 authenticated translations by seven translators from the Eastern Han through the Western Jin, then compare eight disputed texts with An Shigao’s profile. Two texts, T1557 and T0101, show the strongest stylistic similarity to the authenticated An Shigao corpus, with scores of 0.783 and 0.687, respectively. The attributions agree with those reported by a published BERT-based approach on the same set of disputed texts. The framework requires no task-specific training and allows scholars to inspect which linguistic features support each proposed attribution.

[NLP-41] Synapse-Control: Making Agent Experience Actionable with Lightweight Runtime Control

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型代理在执行复杂工具依赖任务时，因重复调用生成式诊断（Generative Diagnosis）导致的推理开销过高与效率低下问题。现有系统如Sentry需频繁调用大模型生成故障诊断以复用经验，显著增加了计算成本。其核心解决方案是提出Synapse-Control代理运行时架构，其关键在于设计轻量级控制平面：通过规则筛选相关建议，利用一个仅1.7B参数、基于教师标注的状态-建议对进行微调的分类器对候选建议进行评分，而非生成诊断；同时引入微合约（Micro-contracts）编码可复用的接口校验逻辑（如必填参数或有效选项），避免对完整任务程序的硬性规定；并借助提示价值表（Prompt Value Table）记录历史指导与反馈，通过冷却机制和令牌预算检查抑制重复建议。实验表明，在AppWorld和WebShop上的多轮测试中，Synapse-Control相比基线模型提升成功率29.8%，减少4,987次生成式诊断调用，并分别降低50.2%和51.0%的辅助控制时间，显著提升了经验复用效率与系统性能。

Abstract:Large language model agents reuse execution experience to improve reliability on complex tool-based tasks. Systems such as Sentry call large models to generate failure diagnoses before retrieving advice, adding inference cost to experience reuse. We present Synapse-Control, an agent runtime whose lightweight control plane selects advice and determines when to send it to the task-executing model. Rules shortlist relevant advice, and a lightweight 1.7B classifier fine-tuned on teacher-labeled state-suggestion pairs scores those candidates instead of generating a diagnosis. Micro-contracts encode reusable interface checks, such as required arguments or valid options, without prescribing complete task programs. A Prompt Value Table records earlier guidance and feedback to limit repeated suggestions through cooldown and token-budget checks. Across 1,308 attempts per method in AppWorld and WebShop, Synapse-Control achieves 270 successes (29.8% more than Base), replaces 4,987 generative diagnosis calls, and reduces auxiliary control time relative to Sentry by 50.2% and 51.0%, respectively.

[NLP-42] Post-OCR Correction of Mixed-Script Uzbek Text: Byte-Level ByT5 with an Empirical Homoglyph Noise Matrix STOC

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决乌兹别克斯坦官方与技术文档中由于拉丁字母与西里尔字母间存在大量同形异义字符（homoglyphs）而导致的光学字符识别（OCR）错误问题。在文字书写系统过渡阶段，拉丁文与西里尔文常在同一页面甚至同一句中混用，导致同形异义错误密度较单一文字系统文本高出近五倍。针对此问题，研究提出一种在本地硬件上部署的解决方案，其核心在于结合字节级ByT5模型与基于359个手动标注错误事件估计采样权重的噪声生成器，并引入基于莱文施泰因距离（Levenshtein distance）约束的保守解码规则。该方法在包含5,204行文本对的黄金测试集上，将字符错误率从0.0578降低至0.0369，成功恢复91.3%的同形异义字符，同时仅引入84个新错误，显著提升了多文种混合文本的OCR准确性。

Abstract:In Uzbek official and technical documents, a large share of OCR errors is caused not by poor image quality but by characters that are visually identical across the two alphabets in use. Because the script transition is still under way, Cyrillic and Latin appear on the same page and often within a single sentence, and in our measurements the density of homoglyph errors on such pages is close to five times higher than in single-script text. We study this problem in a setting where the corpus of engineering-geological and ICT infrastructure reports may not leave the organisation, so every stage was executed on local hardware. The proposed system combines a byte-level ByT5 model with a noise generator whose sampling weights are estimated from 359 manually classified error events, together with a Levenshtein-bounded conservative decoding rule. On a Gold set of 5,204 line pairs it lowers the character error rate from 0.0578 to 0.0369, restores 91.3% of the homoglyphs and introduces only 84 new errors.

[NLP-43] One Byte One Token: Byteifying a 27B Hybrid-Attention LLM with Self-Generated Data

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决将已训练的270亿参数子词模型（subword model）直接转换为纯字节级模型（byte-level model，即一个字节对应一个标记）的问题，同时在不引入补丁结构（patching structure）或局部编码器（local encoder）的前提下，尽可能保留原模型的大部分能力。其核心挑战在于：字节级表示会隐藏中文的拼写信息（如拼音、形声结构），可能削弱模型对汉字语义和结构的理解能力。解决方案的关键在于通过大幅缩减词汇表至384个条目（包含256个标准字节符号及特殊标识符），并保持其余所有权重不变，仅对模型进行两阶段课程学习（curriculum learning）微调——第一阶段专注于字节编码，第二阶段聚焦于知识读取。监督信号完全由原始模型自生成（on-policy），涵盖对话、行为、编码任务等，其中54%的数据来自百科全书文本。实验表明，该方法在多个基准测试中（如MATH-500、HumanEval+、MMLU-Pro、非思考模式GSM8K）与原模型性能差距处于可接受范围内，但在涉及深度汉字认知的任务（如发音、笔画数）上出现显著退化，且思考模式无法弥补这一缺陷。此外，尽管字符级任务表现优异（如CUTE、EXECUTE-zho），但因每步输出量减少3–5倍，导致吞吐率下降约四分之一，预填充延迟增加6.5倍。研究还系统总结了四种字节级模型的失效模式及其修复策略。

Abstract:Byte-level BPE fragments Chinese text (for Qwen3.8 on Chinese Wikipedia, 3.84 bytes per token on average; 64% of tokens are single characters) and hides spelling from the model. We ask whether an already-trained 27B subword model can be converted directly into a pure byte-level model (one byte, one token), without a patching structure or a local encoder, while keeping most of its ability. Starting from Qwen3.8-27B (48 Gated DeltaNet layers + 16 full-attention layers), we shrink the vocabulary from 248,320 to 384 entries (the 256 byte symbols already in the BPE vocabulary plus special ids), leave every other weight untouched, and continue training in a two-stage curriculum (encoding first, then reading) on 4.77 GB of supervised bytes: all dialogue/behavioral supervision is generated on-policy by the original model itself (character dictionary, word dictionary, general dialogue, coding sessions), and knowledge reading uses encyclopedia text (54% of supervised bytes). Training takes 178.6 h on 8xH200. On the same GPU and serving stack, the byte model’s gap to the original falls within the paired bootstrap interval on MATH-500, HumanEval+, MMLU-Pro and non-thinking GSM8K, and it loses 4-6 points on C-Eval, thinking-mode GSM8K and non-thinking IFEval. Without thinking it leads on every character-level task (CUTE 75.2 - 84.0, EXECUTE-zho 81.6 - 93.9, our Chinese character suite 54.4 - 64.0), but lookup knowledge about Chinese characters such as pronunciation and stroke count drops, and thinking does not recover it. The cost is throughput: per-step speed is identical, but each step yields 3-5x less output; Chinese characters per second is about 1/4 of the original, and prefill at 64K bytes is 6.5x slower. We also document four byte-model failure modes (greedy runaway, sampling breaking UTF-8, ineffective penalty terms on a small vocabulary, repetition) and their fixes.

[NLP-44] Compute the Interactions Not the Attributes: What a Fact Layer Must Supply in the Chinese Sexagenary System

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在规则驱动领域中，语言模型系统与确定性事实层结合时，事实层应提供何种事实这一关键问题缺乏量化评估的困境。其核心挑战在于：尽管生成式AI（Generative AI）在开放域任务中表现优异，但在需要精确逻辑推理与多属性组合计算的封闭规则系统中，直接依赖静态事实或简单属性查询难以实现准确推断。研究以中国传统命理学中的干支系统（BaZi）为实验场景，构建了包含682个可验证事实项及160个流转-出生冲突项的基准测试集，并在不同推理模式下进行评估。结果显示，仅依赖静态属性的事实层无法有效提升模型性能，而通过查询过滤机制构建的动态事实层（query-filtered layer）显著提升了多个大模型的表现，使Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B的准确率提升至78%–92%，其他模型达到96%–100%。此外，三款专有推理模型在无外部辅助下即可完成68%–95%的冲突计算。在国际象棋位置预测任务中也验证了相同结论：属性无法替代关系信息，且错误常源于干扰项的误归因。因此，解决方案的关键在于：事实层必须主动提供经过计算的交互关系（computed interactions），其呈现形式需根据模型架构与具体领域需求进行适配。

作者: Huixue Han,Jiaying Liu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Language-model systems in rule-governed domains often pair the model with a deterministic fact layer, but which facts that layer should supply is rarely measured. We measure it in the Chinese sexagenary system underlying BaZi chart analysis, where every fact has one table-checkable value: 682 items over twelve fact categories and 160 transit–natal collision items, posed closed-book, with the reference table, and with computed facts at increasing levels. In eleven open-weight models answering directly, errors concentrate where attributes must be combined: none gets more than 4% of sexagenary days or 1% of collisions right. Static attributes have no consistent effect, and the complete relation list leaves most direct-answering models near zero although it contains the answer. A query-filtered layer (exploratory) raises Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B to 78–92% and four further models to 96–100%. Three proprietary reasoning models compute 68–95% of collisions unaided. On chess positions, under predictions locked in advance, attributes again do not substitute for relations and listed distractors are misattributed. The fact layer must supply computed interactions; how they are presented depends on the model and the domain.

[NLP-45] owards Reliable VLM Judges: State-Conditional Invariance and Presentation-Aware Diagnostics NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）作为多模态与具身任务自动化评判者时，其判断结果的可靠性问题。现有评估方法仅关注整体准确率或一致性，无法揭示模型是否因正确原因做出决策。为此，论文提出状态条件不变性（State-Conditional Invariance, SCI）这一可靠性原则，要求评判模型在保持语义不变的前提下对呈现方式的变化保持稳定，同时对影响任务结果的因果干预作出合理响应。关键解决方案在于构建GridWM-Judge——一个基于确定性MiniGrid轨迹的仿真基准测试平台，包含完整、证据移除和反事实三种变体，并集成呈现方式与表征探针，用于诊断模型在局部感知、动作条件转移、呈现稳定性、表征可交换性以及全量-反事实因果区分等方面的性能。实验表明，模型存在异质性失败模式，如对证据呈现与编码敏感、对成功轨迹激活不足、反事实判别能力弱等，且视觉锚定与目标恢复成为显著的、依赖模型的瓶颈。因此，论文主张应联合报告正确性、呈现稳定性与因果敏感性，而非依赖单一指标。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13596
作者: Qinan Zhang,Xinyu Wang,Qihang Jin,Tianyuan Wang,Hongbing Luo,Pengfei Li,Wenjun Lv,Yu Kang,Jian Di
机构: University of Science and Technology of China(中国科学技术大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). 47 pages, 16 figures. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL ; Data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal and embodied tasks, yet aggregate accuracy or consistency alone does not reveal whether a judge changes its verdict for the right reason. We propose State-Conditional Invariance (SCI), a reliability principle requiring a judge to remain stable under semantics-preserving changes in presentation while responding to causal interventions that change the task outcome. We instantiate SCI in GridWM-Judge, a simulator-grounded diagnostic benchmark built from deterministic MiniGrid trajectories with aligned Full, evidence-removal, and counterfactual variants, plus presentation and representation probes. Across five diagnostic tasks, GridWM-Judge tests local perception, action-conditioned transitions, presentation stability, representation exchangeability, and Full-CF causal discrimination. Our diagnostic evaluations reveal heterogeneous failure modes, including sensitivity to evidence presentation and encoding, low activation on successful trajectories, and weak paired counterfactual discrimination. Perception-controlled analyses further indicate that visual grounding and objective recovery are substantial, model-dependent bottlenecks. These results motivate jointly reporting correctness, presentation stability, and causal sensitivity instead of relying on a single score.

[NLP-46] POEM: Output-Relative Block-Sparse Attention for Long-Context Prefilling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在实际部署中面临的双重挑战：一方面需确保生成内容的安全性以抵御越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks），另一方面需保持模型对良性请求的响应能力，避免过度拒绝（over-refusal）。现有基于表示空间的防御方法通常依赖预定义的引导方向或学习到的安全区域来调节内部激活，但在不依赖预设目标的情况下动态适应输入并控制干预强度仍存在困难。为此，本文提出一种无需目标（target-free）的熵引导残差调制（Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation, TERM）机制，其核心在于利用提示校准的注意力熵偏差作为自适应干预信号，在推理阶段动态调节模型自身的残差更新。通过将注意力熵相对于各输入的预填充（prefill）阶段基线进行校准，构建输入特异性参考，从而减少对正常安全敏感请求的误判；结合自适应尺度归一化与时间累积策略，有效处理熵偏差的尺度差异与持续性，生成可控的干预强度信号。该信号以有界方式缩放模型自身残差更新，无需依赖预设的安全方向，实现了对越狱攻击的有效防御，同时在多种主流模型（Llama、Qwen、Gemma，含Qwen3 0.6B至32B）上展现出优异的鲁棒性与低过拒率，且推理开销较小。

作者: Haoyi Wu,Yunkai Dang,Wanyu Zhang,Lei Wang,Wenbin Li
机构: Nanjing University (南京大学); University of Wollongong (卧龙岗大学); Shenzhen Research Institute of Nanjing University (南京大学深圳研究院)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across diverse applications, making both safety and utility essential for reliable deployment. Jailbreak attacks use diverse forms of adversarial prompting to bypass alignment safeguards and induce LLMs to generate harmful responses. Some representation-based defenses regulate internal activations using predefined steering directions or learned safety regions. However, adapting intervention to each input without a predefined representational target while limiting over-refusal remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation (TERM), an inference-time defense that uses prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviations to guide adaptive modulation of the model’s own residual updates. Attention patterns vary across prompts and decoding steps, making raw entropy values difficult to interpret as a consistent signal for intervention. We therefore calibrate attention entropy against each prompt’s own prefill baseline to establish an input-specific reference for reducing unnecessary intervention on benign requests. Adaptive scale normalization and temporal accumulation then account for differences in deviation scale and persistence to determine intervention strength. The resulting signal controls bounded scaling of the model’s own residual updates, without relying on a predefined safety direction. We compare our method with seven defenses on seven jailbreak attacks and two over-refusal benchmarks across Llama, Qwen, and Gemma models, including Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B. Results show our method improves jailbreak robustness while maintaining low over-refusal on benign safety-sensitive requests with modest inference overhead.

[NLP-47] ERM: Target-Free Jailbreak Defense via Entropy-Guided Residual Modulation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在实际部署中面临的双重挑战：一方面需抵御“越狱攻击”（jailbreak attacks），即攻击者通过对抗性提示绕过对齐安全机制，诱导模型生成有害内容；另一方面需避免过度拒绝（over-refusal），即对本应合法的安全敏感请求误判为危险而拒绝响应。现有基于表示空间的防御方法通常依赖预设的引导方向或学习到的安全区域进行干预，但在缺乏明确目标表示的情况下难以自适应地调整干预强度，易导致保护不足或误伤正常请求。本文提出一种无需目标（target-free）的熵引导残差调制（Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation, TERM）方法，其核心在于利用提示校准后的注意力熵偏差（prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviation）作为动态信号，在推理阶段自适应地调节模型自身的残差更新。通过将注意力熵与每个输入的预填充（prefill）阶段基线进行对比，建立输入特异性的参考标准，从而减少对良性请求的误干预；同时引入自适应尺度归一化与时间累积机制，以处理偏差幅度和持续性的差异，最终生成可控的、有界的比例缩放因子，作用于模型内部残差路径，实现不依赖预定义安全方向的动态防御。实验表明，TERM在多种主流模型（Llama、Qwen、Gemma，涵盖0.6B至32B参数量级）上均显著提升对七类越狱攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持较低的过度拒绝率，且仅带来适度的推理开销。

[NLP-48] Pair-Merge Tokenisation Is Hard to Approximate on Binary Strings and Strongly NP-Hard on Unary Datasets

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 中文本分词（tokenisation）效率优化的核心问题：如何在多项式时间内选择 $ k $ 次合并操作，使长度为 $ n $ 的字符串尽可能缩短，从而减少后续计算开销。现有方法如字节对编码（Byte-Pair Encoding, BPE）通过重复合并相邻符号对来压缩文本，但其最优性缺乏理论保障。论文证明，在除非 P = NP 的前提下，任何多项式时间算法都无法达到优于 $ c \cdot n / \log n （（（ c > 0 $ 为常数）的近似比，即使对于单一二进制字符串和全局替换型 BPE 式合并规则亦然。其关键创新在于将 $ k $ 次合并操作建模为具有 $ k $ 条规则的上下文无关语法（grammar），并利用顶点覆盖（vertex cover）的近似难解性转化为语法规模（grammar size）的下界，再通过重标记副本的二进制编码与显式合并构造实现该下界。针对可跳过出现位置的合并情形，论文提出一个简单算法可实现 $ O(n / \log\log n) $ 的近似比，并指出除非 coNP ⊆ NP/poly，否则无法通过 Karp 多项式归约证明更严格的下界。此外，研究还揭示了在单字母字母表下，由 Kastreva 等人遗留的两个分词问题在存在重复字符串的数据集上为强 NP 完全问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13568
作者: Kundan Baliga,Aiden Xie,Aditya Byju
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校); Georgia Institute of Technology (佐治亚理工学院)
类目: Data Structures and Algorithms (cs.DS); Computational Complexity (cs.CC); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 34 pages, 11 figures. Code and certificates: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tokenisers such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) shorten text by repeatedly merging an adjacent pair of symbols into a new one; fewer tokens mean less computation. We ask whether an efficient algorithm can choose k merges that leave a string of length n almost as short as possible; doing nothing is already within a factor n . We prove that, unless P = NP, no polynomial-time algorithm comes within a factor c,n/\log n , for some constant c0 , already for one binary string and for BPE-style merges that replace every occurrence. The key idea is that k merges form a grammar with k rules: a vertex-cover gap becomes a grammar-size gap, which we amplify with relabelled copies, encode in binary and realise with explicit merges. For merges that may skip occurrences, a simple algorithm achieves O(n/\log\log n) , and no Karp reduction can prove hardness beyond order n/\log n unless coNP \subseteq NP/poly. Over a one-letter alphabet, both tokenisation problems left open by Kastreva et al. are strongly NP-complete on datasets with repeated strings.

[NLP-49] A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决临床文本预测任务中，生成式解释方法依赖人工标注概念标签所带来的高成本问题。现有基于概念的解释方法通常需要大量带标注的概念标签来训练模型识别输入中的医学概念，而临床文本的标注过程复杂且昂贵。为克服这一限制，论文提出一种无需概念监督的新型框架，其核心创新在于设计了一种定制化的交叉注意力瓶颈（cross-attention bottleneck），通过预训练语言模型对临床文本及医学概念描述进行嵌入，并利用交叉注意力机制自动推断每个概念在文本中的相关性，生成概念重要性得分。这些得分经池化后用于线性预测层，实现对临床结局的可解释建模。实验结果表明，该框架在胸外伤严重程度分层与院内死亡率预测两个任务上，性能接近黑箱模型（AUROC差距小于0.02），同时支持队列级和患者级的解释能力，有效揭示了概念在整个队列中的总体重要性及个体患者的特定贡献。因此，该方案的关键在于通过无监督的交叉注意力机制实现无需标注的概念感知，从而在保持强预测性能的同时显著提升临床文本模型的透明度。
