点击查看摘要

Abstract:Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. A cross-attention module then estimates the presence of each concept for each text token, producing concept relevance scores that capture how concepts are involved throughout the note. These scores are pooled and used in a linear prediction layer to model clinical outcomes in an interpretable manner. Results: The performance of the proposed framework was compared against blackbox models across two tasks: chest trauma severity stratification using a private dataset and an in-hospital mortality prediction task using the publicly available MIMIC-III dataset. The proposed framework achieved AUROC values within 0.02 of the corresponding blackbox models. The framework also enabled cohort- and patient-level interpretation, capturing the overall concept importance across the cohort and patient-specific concept contributions. Conclusion: Our proposed framework realizes concept-based interpretation without requiring ground-truth concept presence labels. It improves the transparency of clinical text predictions while maintaining strong performance in clinical prediction tasks.

[NLP-50] An evidence-traceable benchmark of clinical reasoning in large language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医学大语言模型（Medical Large Language Models, LLMs）基准测试得分难以解释的问题，即评分标准缺乏与临床证据的可追溯性。其解决方案的关键在于构建了“医学证据基准”（Med Evidence Bench, MEB），包含1,536个由医师构建的评测项，涵盖三个层级：指南知识、标准化临床情景和真实世界实验室情景。每个医疗主张（medical claim）均关联至版本化的原始文献片段，实现了证据链的可追溯性。通过引入证据溯源评分（Evidence Trace Score, ETS），研究发现不同模型在各层级的表现差异显著：指南知识层面的ETS为0.975–0.997，而标准化情景和真实世界情景分别为0.292–0.658和0.182–0.447；尤其在真实世界情景中，模型识别临床信息的能力（平均0.770）远高于匹配证据（0.165）或提出建议（0.160）。自动化评分与三位医师多数投票结果具有较高一致性（宏观F1=0.930），但证据应用环节一致性较低。研究结果表明，模型对指南内容的记忆并不等同于个体化临床证据的应用能力，也无法证明其临床有效性。

Abstract:Benchmark scores for medical large language models (LLMs) are difficult to interpret when scoring criteria cannot be traced to clinical evidence. Here we developed Med Evidence Bench (MEB; this https URL), comprising 1,536 physician-constructed items across three levels: guideline knowledge, standardized clinical scenarios and real-world laboratory scenarios. Each criterion stating a medical claim is linked to a versioned source-text span. Across ten LLMs, the Evidence Trace Score (ETS) was 0.975-0.997 for guideline knowledge, 0.292-0.658 for standardized scenarios and 0.182-0.447 for real-world scenarios, and rankings varied across levels. For real-world scenarios, scores for identifying clinical information (mean, 0.770) exceeded those for matching evidence (0.165) or formulating recommendations (0.160). On 1,296 criterion-level judgments, automated grading agreed with the majority vote of three physicians (macro-F1, 0.930; 95% confidence interval, 0.915-0.945), although agreement was lower for evidence application. These findings from Chinese-language materials indicate that guideline recall does not ensure patient-specific evidence use and do not establish clinical effectiveness.

[NLP-51] Are Dense Rewards Worth Their Tokens in GRPO?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）在训练语言模型进行推理时，评估与优化策略的偏差问题。现有方法如组相对策略优化（GRPO）对解题过程中的每个词元赋予相同奖励，而密集过程奖励（dense process rewards）通过蒙特卡洛采样评估中间步骤以提升反馈精度，但其实际代价被低估——仅连续生成部分就占用了91%的生成词元。为此，作者提出“匹配计算协议”（matched-compute protocol），确保所有训练干预在生成词元数和训练GPU小时数上具有相同的计算预算，并在预注册研究中引入对照机制控制副作用。实验覆盖6个模型共1,668次运行发现，当计算量相等时，匹配计算使蒙特卡洛奖励的性能排名反转：在Qwen2.5-1.5B上，尽管其单次更新优于标准GRPO，但在相同词元数量下准确率低14.3个百分点，相同训练时间下低7.8个百分点，且四种密集奖励变体均未超越GRPO。此外，基于梯度测试的每词元评估虽能正确排序奖励方式，但普遍高估各方法效果1至2个百分点，接近其宣称的增益幅度。相反，在预测成功概率最接近0.5的提示样本上进行训练，可在匹配计算下实现显著提升：在Qwen3-0.6B上提高1.7个百分点，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上提高0.8个百分点，且结果在新种子和未见问题上可复现；这一策略还提前预测了五项预注册测试中的四个。这些收益在训练早期即显现，而使用两倍初始学习率的标准GRPO即可逼近其性能。因此，论文的核心结论是：训练干预必须在匹配计算条件下验证，这不仅揭示了部分看似有效的改进实为计算资源不均衡所致的假象，也证实了特定提示选择策略的有效性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:RLVR trains language models to reason by rewarding correct final answers. A widely used algorithm, group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), gives every token of a solution the same credit, so dense process rewards have been proposed to credit intermediate steps, for example with a Monte-Carlo reward that scores each step by sampling continuations from it. Comparing such a reward with GRPO per training update, or vetting it with a gradient test on a single batch, leaves out what it costs: in our setting, the continuations alone take 91% of all generated tokens. We introduce a matched-compute protocol that gives every training intervention the same budget, measured in generated tokens and training GPU-hours, and tests it in preregistered studies with controls for side effects. Across 1,668 runs on six models, matching compute reverses the ranking. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, the Monte-Carlo reward leads standard GRPO per update, yet ends 14.3 percentage points lower at equal tokens and 7.8 points lower at equal training time, and none of four dense-reward variants outperforms GRPO even with as much training time. A per-token gradient test orders these rewards as training does but overestimates each by one to two points, as much as the gains it is meant to detect. In contrast, training on the prompts whose predicted success is nearest 1/2 improves accuracy at matched compute, by 1.7 points on Qwen3-0.6B and 0.8 on Qwen2.5-1.5B. These gains replicate on fresh seeds and unseen problems, and a simple rule, that the candidate prompts are predicted to fail more often than not, predicted where they appear in five of six preregistered tests. Both gains come early in training, and standard GRPO with twice the initial learning rate comes within half a point of them. We argue that training interventions should be validated at matched compute, which overturns some apparent gains and confirms others.

[NLP-52] Darmok: Championship Cryptic Crossword Solving via Constraint Tightening and Resilient Orchestration

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在英国式字谜填字游戏（cryptic crossword）中实现超人类表现的挑战，此类谜题具有表面语义误导性强、定义与词法构造混合隐藏、网格稀疏导致大量字母未被交叉验证等特点，且比赛规则对任何错误或空格均采取“零容忍”策略。为突破现有生成式AI模型在实际应用中因云接口延迟、超时、安全拒绝或陷入推理死循环而引发的可靠性瓶颈，论文提出Darmok系统，其核心解决方案在于构建多阶段协同验证机制：通过三个独立模型对线索进行交叉验证；利用已确认的交叉字母解锁高难度线索；结合全谜题级模型与词典查表完成剩余空白，同时避免覆盖已确认词汇。该设计实现了五个月每日评估中的近零误差表现，尽管在常规基准下冗余组件影响微乎其微，但在极端情况（如主模型严重延迟）下，备用路径仍确保了系统的完整求解能力，揭示出当基础模型趋于掌握平均性能时，复杂人工智能系统的核心挑战已从准确性转向最坏情况下的鲁棒性。

作者: Siddhartha Chatterjee(The University of Texas at Austin)
机构: The University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC)
备注: 60 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present Darmok, the first automated system to reach superhuman performance on British cryptic crosswords. Unlike American-style crosswords, cryptic clues disguise an unmarked definition and compositional wordplay beneath a misleading surface reading, sparse grids leave nearly half of each word’s letters unchecked, and tournament rules rank a grid with even a single wrong or blank square behind all error-free solutions regardless of speed. Competing alongside an elite human field at the 55th Times Crossword Championship in London, Darmok solved all seven championship puzzles error-free and finished faster than every human competitor in every round. It solved the Final puzzle in 6m 52s, a full 3m 13s ahead of the human champion. Today’s frontier AI models can on average solve a whole puzzle in a single try with comparable accuracy and speed. However, cloud API calls still stall, time out, trigger safety refusals, or get stuck in reasoning loops. To simultaneously achieve tournament-grade accuracy, speed, and reliability, Darmok cross-checks clues across three independent models in rounds; uses verified crossing letters to unlock harder clues; and uses a whole-puzzle model and dictionary lookups to fill any remaining gaps without overwriting confirmed words. This design maintained near-zero-error performance across a five-month daily evaluation period. Under normal benchmark conditions, removing backup models, fallback steps, or elaborate prompt instructions barely changes accuracy, making the architecture appear over-engineered. Yet during both the worst days of daily operation and a severe slowdown of our primary model in the live Championship Final, the backup paths carried the solve, showing that as foundation models master the average case, the central challenge in building complex AI systems shifts to resilience in the worst case. [NLP-53] How Post-Training Influences Verbalized Algorithmic Computation in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决后训练（post-training）阶段如何影响语言模型内部信息利用方式及显式链式思维（Chain of Thought, CoT）表达有效性的问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管后训练可提升模型推理能力，但其对内部状态（如进位值）的表征变化以及对书面推理过程的依赖程度尚不清晰。研究通过分析Olmo-3-7B-Instruct模型在多数字加法任务中经历的持续监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和强化学习视觉反馈（RLVR）等不同阶段的检查点，发现虽然内部激活中进位信息在SFT与RLVR阶段的可恢复性相似，但仅在RLVR阶段生成的CoT表现出显著更高的推理准确性，并且与进位相关的语句在模型决策中的重要性评分也明显提升。这表明，后训练不仅改变了模型对书面推理内容的敏感度，更关键的是提升了其对推理内容的实际利用效率——即增强对相关语义线索的响应能力并转化为更高性能，而单纯的敏感度提升（如DPO阶段）并不必然带来性能改善。因此，解决方案的关键在于：通过强化学习类方法（如RLVR）促进模型将内部状态与显式推理过程更有效地对齐，从而实现从“能写”到“写得有用”的质变。

作者: Niall Dalton
机构: University College London (伦敦大学学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Post-training improves language-model reasoning, but how it changes the use of internal information and verbalized chain of thought (CoT) remains unclear. We study successive SFT, DPO, and RLVR checkpoints of Olmo-3-7B-Instruct on multi-digit addition, using carry values as known intermediate state. Probes recover carry information from internal activations with similar accuracy in SFT and RLVR, although manipulating this information does not reliably control model outputs. In contrast, the usefulness of verbalized reasoning differs: CoTs produced by RLVR yield higher accuracy across receiving checkpoints than those produced by SFT or DPO. We also show that carry-related statements receive higher importance scores after RLVR than matched random controls. DPO shows similar sensitivity to carry-related statements but without comparable accuracy gains. These results suggest that post-training changes the usefulness of written reasoning and sensitivity to its content in meaningful ways, although greater sensitivity does not necessarily coincide with better problem performance.

[NLP-54] Sanity Checks for Attention Surgery: Null Models and Matched Interventions for Representation-Motivated Design

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 模型中自注意力机制（self-attention）组件是否具有冗余性的问题，尤其关注特定注意力头输出中与自身值向量对齐的分量是否可被移除而不影响性能。其核心挑战在于：现有方法常基于内部表示的统计量（如注意力头输出与自身值向量的余弦相似度）判断冗余性，并直接移除相应成分，但缺乏严谨的因果验证，易误判统计显著性、几何不变性及方向特异性。为此，作者提出三个可复用的检验框架：1）评估统计量是否显著高于噪声基线；2）检验该统计量在几何零假设下是否仍存在；3）验证训练收益是否依赖于被移除方向的特定性。通过在九个多头预训练模型（5,408 个注意力头，参数量 124M 至 6.9B）上应用这些检验发现，早期位置的因果零假设解释了 48%–63% 的头-值余弦对齐，且无单调尺度趋势；在分组查询注意力（grouped-query attention）中，该对齐仅存在于同一键值组内，跨组则反向（组内 +0.24 至 +0.27，跨组 -0.11 至 -0.19）。分裂半可靠性分析显示，每头干预效应在 GPT-2 中可分辨（Δr = 0.80），但在 Pythia-160M（0.42）和 Pythia-410M（0.53）中减弱，而结构自余弦可靠性在三者中均接近完美（r_stat ≈ 0.99），表明预测能力具有模型依赖性。在一项注册的 3臂×8种子配对因子实验中（每轮 4.0×10⁸ 标记，共 3.999 亿标记），固定任意秩一方向与基线无差异（+0.0011 nats，p = 0.197），而自指向移除显著降低验证损失（-0.0029 nats，Holm 校正后 p = 0.0023），并优于固定控制（-0.0040 nats，p = 0.0018）。结果表明，在约 5090 万规模下，训练增益确实依赖于自身值方向而非任意方向，但大余弦对齐本身不足以证明冻结模型中的冗余性。因此，解决方案的关键在于引入系统性因果检验框架，以避免对注意力冗余性的误判，强调必须同时满足统计显著性、几何鲁棒性与方向特异性才能确认可移除性。

Abstract:Transformer architectural modifications frequently measure a statistic on internal representations, observe that it is large, remove it architecturally, and report an improvement. Interpreting that sequence requires evaluating whether the statistic exceeds its noise floor, whether it survives a geometric null, and whether the training gain requires the specific direction removed. We formulate these requirements as three reusable checks and apply them to self-attention removal, which deletes the component of an attention head’s output aligned with its own value vector. Across nine multi-head pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M to 6.9B parameters), an earlier-position causal null accounts for 48% to 63% of the head-value cosine alignment, with no monotone scale trend. Under grouped-query attention, this alignment is specific to each head’s own key-value group and reverses across groups (+0.24 to +0.27 within-group, -0.11 to -0.19 across-group). Split-half reliability demonstrates that the per-head intervention effect is resolvable in GPT-2 ( r_\Delta = 0.80 ) but attenuated in Pythia-160M (0.42) and Pythia-410M (0.53), whereas structural self-cosine reliability is near-perfect in all three ( r_\textstat 0.99 ); which statistic predicts its own intervention is model-dependent. In a pre-registered 3-arm by 8-seed paired factorial at 4.0 \times 10^8 tokens per run (399,900,672 tokens), a fixed arbitrary rank-one direction does not differ from baseline (+0.0011 nats, p = 0.197 ), while self-directed removal lowers validation loss (-0.0029 nats, Holm-corrected p = 0.0023 ) and outperforms the fixed arbitrary control directly (-0.0040 nats, p = 0.0018 ). At 50.9M scale the training benefit requires the own-value direction rather than a fixed arbitrary one, but a large cosine alignment alone does not establish redundancy in frozen models.

[NLP-55] Framing-Induced Vulnerability in Large Language Models : Evidence from Chinese News Headlines

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在新闻内容评估中是否存在对信息框架（framing）的敏感性，即模型对新闻标题的判断是基于事实本身，还是受标题表述方式的影响。其核心问题是：当仅改变标题的表达框架时，大语言模型是否会因此产生对事件严重性或误导性的误判，从而影响新闻筛选与分发的公正性。研究的关键解决方案在于通过结合大规模生态审计（63,926条中文新闻标题）与受控实验，系统检验四款中国主流大语言模型（DeepSeek、MiMo、Dots、LongCat）在不同标题框架下的表现。结果表明，仅改变标题的语义框架即可显著影响模型对事件严重性和误导性的判断，且效应方向一致，说明模型存在显著的“框架偏差”；而提供正文内容可使这种偏差降低54%至80%，且所有减少均在统计上显著（p < 0.01）。这揭示出当前仅依赖标题进行评估的生成式AI（Generative AI）系统存在可量化的鲁棒性缺陷，提示在实际部署与治理中，应将“框架敏感性”作为关键可靠性指标加以考量。

作者: Mo Zhou,Yiwei Zhang
机构: Nanjing Normal University (南京师范大学); Communication University of China (中国传媒大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 7 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models increasingly evaluate, route, and moderate news, so a model’s judgment of a headline has become a gatekeeping decision. We ask whether that judgment follows the fact being reported or the way the fact is framed. We combine an ecological audit of 63,926 Chinese news headlines with a controlled experiment. The experiment covers 30 real events, 30 synthetic events, and 29 natural headline pairs, tested on four Chinese models. Changing only the headline frame shifted both perceived misleadingness and event severity, and the direction and ordering of the shifts were the same for DeepSeek, MiMo, Dots, and LongCat. Emotionally intensified headlines raised severity ratings by 0.65 to 0.88 points, whereas positively reframed headlines lowered them by 0.34 to 0.52 points. Supplying the article body reduced this severity bias by 54 to 80 percent, and all four reductions were significant at p .01. A small human reference study showed the same direction of effect. Headline-only LLM evaluation therefore carries a measurable robustness gap, and framing sensitivity belongs among the reliability properties that deployment and governance check.

[NLP-56] Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决惯性里程计（Inertial Odometry）在长期运行中因传感器噪声与偏差积分导致的累积漂移（unbounded drift）问题。传统方法如TLIO虽采用神经伪测量（neural pseudo-measurements），但其训练过程与下游滤波器解耦，难以实现端到端优化。本文提出可微分滤波（Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry, DFIO），其核心创新在于将误差状态卡尔曼滤波器（error-state Kalman filter）的更新步骤直接嵌入计算图中，实现可微分的滤波更新。在独立预训练后，DFIO通过可微测量更新引入后验位置监督，联合优化位移输出头与协方差输出头，从而提升轨迹估计的准确性与不确定性建模能力。实验结果表明，相较于TLIO基线，DFIO在行人数据集上分别降低了13.2%的平均绝对位移误差和39.6%的一秒相对位移误差；在未校准智能手机惯性数据上的评估也验证了其在高噪声条件下有效抑制平移漂移并保持轨迹对齐的能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13517
作者: Yaru Gu,Ting Zou
机构: Memorial University of Newfoundland (纽芬兰纪念大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 19 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Accurate inertial odometry is critical for autonomous systems but suffers from unbounded drift caused by the integration of sensor noise and biases. In approaches such as TLIO, neural pseudo-measurements are trained independently of their downstream filter. This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry (DFIO), a learning framework that embeds the update stages of an error-state Kalman filter directly into a computational graph. Following standalone pre-training, DFIO jointly optimizes the displacement and covariance output heads using posterior-position supervision through differentiable measurement updates. The proposed system is validated on public pedestrian motion datasets featuring both calibrated and uncalibrated inertial measurements. Experimental results on a pedestrian dataset demonstrate that DFIO reduces mean absolute and one-second relative translation errors by 13.2% and 39.6% relative to the TLIO baseline, and by 7.7% and 17.4% relative to its pre-trained counterpart. Furthermore, evaluations on uncalibrated smartphone inertial data indicate that the proposed method effectively mitigates translational drift and maintains trajectory alignment under highly noisy sensor conditions. Source code will be made publicly available.

[NLP-57] Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在移动设备上部署小型语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）时，如何高效、自动化地实现针对特定任务与目标设备的模型微调与量化，以兼顾性能、隐私保护和离线可用性的问题。当前方法依赖专家反复手动调参，效率低下且难以泛化。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个名为“Mobile AI Factory”的智能体系统，该系统通过一个编排型大语言模型（Orchestrator LLM）动态决策是否进行超参数调优、真实数据挖掘或合成样本生成，并结合固定回滚规则确保模型精度不下降；系统从小型模型开始逐步搜索，跨基础模型与量化方案进行迭代，动态调整精度目标，并利用目标设备的真实推理引擎与后端测量数据进行优化。实验表明，该方法在十项任务与四款安卓手机上的表现优于两个五次提示前沿模型，且在实体抽取任务中仅需1/19的GPU时间即可逼近全量训练27种模型变体的最优结果。此外，实测设备性能对最佳配置具有显著影响，若缺乏真实设备测量，即使提供完整硬件与模型规格，仍会在25%的中等难度及60%的高难度案例中未能满足应用需求，凸显了真实设备测量在模型部署中的关键作用。

作者: Evan Li,Krishna Deshpande,Wen Cheng,Shyamnath Gollakota
机构: University of Washington (华盛顿大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present \it Mobile AI Factory, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19 \times less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app’s requirements in 25% of easy and moderate cases and in 60% of hard ones. Code is available at: this https URL.

[NLP-58] Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverag e NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在组合泛化（compositional generalization）任务中表现不一致的问题，即模型在训练时仅接触部分模块组合，却需对未见过的组合进行有效推理。其核心挑战在于现有评估方法因依赖有限且随意定义的训练-测试划分，导致结果不可靠。研究通过系统性分析发现，影响组合泛化性能的两个关键因素是组合等价性（composition equivalence）和模块覆盖度差异（module coverage shift）。其中，组合等价性指不同模块序列虽路径不同但最终输出函数相同，而直接模型（direct models）的高表现主要源于对这类等价性的投机性利用；当基准测试消除组合等价性后，模型性能显著下降，表明其无法真正泛化到产生新端到端函数的已知模块组合。此外，随着模块在训练与测试中出现上下文差异（即模块覆盖度差异）增大，无论是直接模型还是逐步推理模型（step-by-step models）的性能均单调下降。这一发现对基准设计具有重要启示：包含组合等价性的基准会严重夸大直接模型的泛化能力，而同时存在组合等价性和覆盖度偏差的基准则会加剧捷径学习（shortcut learning）。作为案例研究，作者验证了组合等价性在预训练模型Llama3-8B于LiveCodeBench代码输出预测任务中的显著影响，揭示其实际泛化能力受限于对表面模式的依赖而非真正的组合理解。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13498
作者: Purva Pruthi,Andrew Yuan,Alexander D’Amour,David Jensen
机构: University of Massachusetts Amherst (马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校); Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.

[NLP-59] Inherited Weights: Measuring the Tokenization Premium and the Sovereignty Cost of Language Models for the Global South

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前全球范围内非中美两国部署的语言模型在多语言适配性与文化主权方面的根本性缺陷，其核心问题在于：大多数海外部署的语言模型均基于少数预训练模型家族进行微调（fine-tuning），而微调无法改变模型底层继承的关键属性，包括词汇表、知识结构、文化对齐性、记忆数据及许可证限制。这些问题导致低资源语言尤其是非洲和南美原住民语言在分词时出现严重的“分词溢价”（tokenization premium）——例如阿姆哈拉语在旧版分词器中溢价高达10倍，即使在最新商业分词器中仍达6.8倍；南美原住民语言的溢价介于1.6至2.7倍之间。解决方案的关键在于三个方面：第一，提出可复现的跨31种语言、7种2023–2024年发布的分词器的分词溢价测量方法，并通过明确修正未知词符（unknown-token collapse）实现更准确评估；第二，设计了一套无需访问模型权重的八项黑盒主权审计测试（black-box sovereignty audit），使购买方可在不依赖内部参数的情况下验证模型的自主可控性；第三，提出“制度性论证”（regime argument），主张在能源与法律责任约束下，应以每焦耳能量的准确性、校准度及选择性风险控制作为模型设计的核心目标，而非单纯追求原始准确率，且相关指标需具备抗“回避策略”（abstention）膨胀的能力。研究最后报告了基于上述理念构建的私有架构的初步内部测试结果，同时公开数据与测量代码以支持可复现性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Most language models deployed outside the United States and China are fine-tuned descendants of a small number of pretrained families. We argue that fine-tuning leaves the decisive properties of a model inherited from its base: vocabulary, knowledge, cultural alignment, memorized data and license. We contribute (i) an updated, reproducible measurement of the tokenization premium across 31 languages and 7 tokenizers released in 2023-2024, on 27 articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, with explicit correction for unknown-token collapse. Premiums reach 10x for Amharic in older tokenizers and remain at 6.8x in the newest commercial one; Indigenous South American languages pay between 1.6x and 2.7x under global tokenizers. A vocabulary built from Portuguese lowers the premium for 11 of 13 Latin-script Global South languages relative to every global tokenizer tested, by about 24% for Guarani and Quechua. (ii) An eight-test black-box sovereignty audit that a buyer can run without access to weights. (iii) A regime argument: under energy and liability constraints, accuracy per joule, calibration and selective risk should replace raw accuracy as design objectives, with metrics that abstention cannot inflate. We close with preliminary internal measurements from a proprietary architecture built around these objectives, reported with their limitations. Data and measurement code are included.

[NLP-60] BioMem: Agent ic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在生物医学领域中，代理记忆系统（agentic memory system）在信息保留、检索、更新与利用方面的有效性与可靠性问题。核心挑战在于如何在跨任务和多轮交互中维持信息的准确性与上下文相关性，尤其在生物医学知识推理、临床预测及长期对话记忆等场景下，面临证据相关性弱、信息失真以及推理利用率低等关键障碍。其解决方案的关键是提出一种无需训练的混合记忆检索与利用框架（Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization, HMRU），通过联合优化证据的可访问性与任务感知的利用能力，显著提升生物医学推理与长期对话记忆性能。实验表明，HMRU 在生物医学问答与对话记忆基准上平均相对提升8.6%，在特定临床预测任务中表现更优，并将对话回答错误率降低24.9%，同时缩小了48.0%与全上下文推理之间的性能差距，为构建更可靠的记忆增强型大语言模型提供了系统性认知与实用路径。

作者: Mingchen Li,Yongkang Xiao,Rumeng Li,Rui Zhang,Hong Yu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.

[NLP-61] Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）生成过程中对完整生成序列的不确定性量化问题，这对于实现选择性预测（selective prediction）和自适应计算资源分配至关重要。现有方法如基于局部熵或对数概率的零成本信号仅反映单个词元层面的信息，而自一致性（self-consistency）虽能提供更全面的估计但需大量额外生成，计算开销高。本文提出的关键解决方案是利用序列蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte Carlo, SMC）解码进行幂采样时，天然可估计幂分布的归一化常数，从而在零边际成本下获得序列级瑞尼熵（Sequence-level Rényi Entropy, SRE），且在任意粒子预算下均具备理论保证。进一步地，通过引入瑞尼链式法则，可扩展得到任意阶次的分步熵度量。研究证明，高于1阶的熵值与每一步最可能词元相关，因此与对数概率高度一致；而1/2阶成员则累积了每步搜索努力的对数，成为13个测试场景中10个的最佳零成本选择性预测信号。在MATH500数据集上，该指标相较对数概率的AUROC提升0.022至0.044，且在不同长度四分位区间内表现稳定，同时在各设置留出验证中仍保持一致最优选择。此外，8粒子探测器可识别出需更多粒子的复杂问题，两阶段策略则在三组随机种子下以34.2%更少的粒子数达到64粒子的精度水平，显著提升了效率。

作者: Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Milad Heidari Sorkhehdizaj,Shahab Rahimirad,Aliasghar Pourghani,Seyedarmin Azizi,Souvik Kundu,Abolfazl Hashemi,Joseph Campbell,Vijay Gupta

类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R’enyi entropy (SRE) of the model’s completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R’enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. An 8-particle probe identifies the problems that benefit from more particles, and a two-pass policy matches 64-particle accuracy on MATH500 with 34.2% fewer particles over three seeds.

[NLP-62] Mapping Instructors Attitudes Towards Cheating with AI: An Exploratory Analysis Using Forum Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在教学与学习环境中引发的学术诚信问题，尤其关注其导致的作弊行为对教育公平、知识获取及学术伦理带来的挑战。研究聚焦于大学教师群体在面对生成式 AI 技术普及后，如何认知和应对学生利用 AI 完成学术任务的现象。其解决方案的关键在于通过对 r/Professors 子版块中超过 201 万条关于作弊讨论的文本数据进行大规模语料分析，系统提炼教师群体在维护学术诚信方面的核心动机与具体策略，进而构建“为何”（why）与“如何”（how）应对作弊的综合框架，揭示未来人工智能与教育深度融合过程中可能面临的潜在风险与治理困境。

Abstract:In teaching and learning environments, cheating and the violation of academic integrity have always been one of the challenges, involving different levels of concerns such as administrative, personal knowledge, learning, and equity. The introduction of large language models has brought cheating in dialogue to the forefront, given the apparent capabilities of these models to complete students’ academic assignments. This study aims to leverage recent dialogues among university professors about cheating with Generative AI to better understand their beliefs about academic honesty. In doing so, we analyze a corpus of 2.01 million posts (threads and comments) in the r/Professors subreddit discussing cheating after the release of ChatGPT, providing a better understanding of teachers’ motivations to discourage cheating and the strategies they use to do so. We synthesize the why and how of addressing cheating to identify caveats about the future of AI and academic integration.

[NLP-63] Understanding Students Rationales for AI-Mediated Cheating: An Instructor Perspective from Online Forums Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在学术环境中被滥用所引发的学术诚信危机，尤其聚焦于当前研究中对教师群体如何看待学生在禁止场景下使用 AI 的动机缺乏深入理解的问题。其解决方案的关键在于通过对 201 万条 r/Professors 社区帖子进行质性分析，系统揭示了教师群体普遍认为学生使用 AI 进行作弊的四大核心动因：（1）学术体系博弈（Academic System Gaming），即学生将 AI 视为绕过僵化评价体系的工具；（2）数字-学术素养鸿沟（Digital-Academic Literacy Gap），反映学生在数字技术应用与学术规范认知之间的不匹配；（3）绩效焦虑（Performance Anxiety），体现学生在高学业压力下对成绩表现的过度担忧；（4）不诚实行为的常态化（Normalization of Dishonesty），指学生对学术不端行为的接受度逐渐提升，形成不良风气。这一分析框架为构建更具针对性的学术治理策略提供了实证依据。

Abstract:The extensive adoption of AI has precipitated a crisis in academic integrity. While studies attempt to quantify cheating, less is known about the motivations instructors believe students have for using AI in prohibited ways. We analyze 2.01 million posts on r/Professors to understand how instructors perceive students’ justifications for AI-mediated cheating. Our qualitative analyses reveal four primary themes: (1) Academic System Gaming, (2) Digital-Academic Literacy Gap, (3) Performance Anxiety, and (4) Normalization of Dishonesty.

[NLP-64] Measuring Definition Sensitivity in LLM Annotation of Social Science Concepts NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在社会科学文本标注任务中因概念定义模糊而导致的标注结果不可靠问题。具体而言，现有研究依赖大语言模型（LLM）通过提示词（prompt）中的概念定义进行标注，但诸如仇恨言论、虚假新闻和恐怖主义等概念往往存在多个理论上合理且相互竞争的定义，而模型实际是依据提示中的定义进行判断，还是基于其预训练过程中形成的固有认知作出标签决策，尚不明确。为此，作者提出通过双重标注实验来检验模型对定义的敏感性：即对同一组文本分别使用不同但具有同等合理性的定义进行标注，并比较两次标注结果的差异，该差异被定义为“定义敏感性”（definition sensitivity）。同时，作为对照，采用语义不变但表述不同的改写版本定义进行标注，以计算“释义基线”（paraphrase floor），从而区分真实定义依赖与表面表述差异的影响。实验结果表明，在六个概念和三种主流大语言模型上，更换竞争性定义所导致的标注变化显著高于释义基线，证明标注结果高度依赖于所输入的定义。因此，研究的关键在于揭示并量化大语言模型在文本标注中的定义敏感性，强调任何基于大语言模型的标注工作必须同时报告其使用的定义及对应的定义敏感性和释义基线，以确保结果可解释、可复现，并避免误导性结论。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13339
作者: Bogdan Mamaev,Qizhou Wang,Christopher Leckie,Matteo Vergani
机构: Deakin University (迪肯大学); University of Melbourne (墨尔本大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE: Can We Trust AI Evaluation? Robustness, Causality, and Risk in Modern AI Assessment

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In social science research, text annotation is a fundamental task that is traditionally a costly, hard-to-scale manual process. Researchers have used large language models (LLMs) to perform annotation by writing a definition of a concept into a prompt - a rule that determines whether a label should be attributed to a text depending on its content. However, concepts such as hate speech, fake news, and terrorism typically have several theoretically defensible competing definitions. It is also unknown whether the model actually applied the definition to provide the label or the label was based on the model’s pretrained notion of the concept. To test this, we have the model annotate the same texts twice, each time with a different definition. We call the disagreement between the two sets of annotations definition sensitivity. As a control, we paraphrase one definition but leave its requirements unchanged - the disagreement between the annotations with the two wordings becomes the paraphrase floor. Across six concepts and three LLMs, a swap of competing definitions always changes more annotations, on average, than a paraphrase. This shows that the annotations depend on the prompted definition, so any set of annotations should be interpreted together with the definition that produced it. The LLM annotator’s definition sensitivity and its paraphrase floor should both be reported in such work.

[NLP-65] Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在高并发长上下文场景下，由于键值缓存（KV-cache）容量与注意力带宽随解码请求池规模线性增长所带来的扩展瓶颈问题。现有并行化策略存在根本性权衡：数据并行导致模型权重复制，限制了KV-cache容量；张量并行在模型的KV头数量上达到注意力扩展极限，并引入跨节点密集通信；而解码上下文并行（DCP）虽通过分片序列恢复容量，却需在节点间聚合部分注意力结果，带来额外开销。本文的关键创新在于提出解码令牌并行（Decode Token Parallelism, TKNP），其核心思想是将权重放置与注意力所有权解耦：将单个模型副本均衡分布于各计算节点，每个活跃节点在其本地执行完整批次的投影与前馈网络（MLP），利用节点内张量并行高效处理；同时，各节点仅需基于本地驻留的KV-cache计算自身请求的注意力。该设计实现了请求局部注意力在节点间的无缝扩展，无需复制权重、仅传输当前令牌激活值，且密集型全归约操作保留在NVLink域内，避免跨节点注意力结果合并。实验表明，在64块H100 GPU上对Llama 3.1 405B和Nemotron-4 340B进行评估，TKNP相较DCP最高提升1.7倍吞吐，相较数据并行最高提升2.06倍，显著优化了长上下文、高并发场景下的生成效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13293
作者: Susav Shrestha,Brad Settlemyer,Narasimha Reddy
机构: 未知
类目: Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 14 pages, 12 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. Existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other: data parallelism replicates model weights, limiting KV capacity; tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model’s KV-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes; and decode context parallelism (DCP) recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. We observe that during decode, dense layers and attention scale differently: dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single NVLink domain, whereas attention cost grows with every active request’s KV cache. We present Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP), a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership. TKNP distributes a single model copy across nodes in balanced layer blocks. The active node holding a block executes its projections and MLP for the full batch using intra-node tensor parallelism, while every node computes attention for its own requests against locally resident KV cache. This extends request-local attention across nodes without replicating weights: only current-token activations cross the network, dense all-reduces remain within NVLink, and attention requires no cross-node merging of partial results. Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on Llama 3.1 405B and Nemotron-4 340B on up to 64 H100 GPUs, TKNP improves completion throughput for long-context, high-concurrency workloads by up to 1.7 \times over DCP and by up to 2.06 \times over data parallelism at matched GPU count.

[NLP-66] What drives the emergence of symbolic mechanisms in large language models ? NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型中涌现的抽象推理能力背后的驱动因素问题，具体聚焦于生成式符号机制（symbolic mechanisms）的形成原因。研究发现，尽管现有工作已识别出此类机制的存在，但其背后的关键驱动力尚不明确。为探究这一问题，作者在抽象序列任务上从零开始训练多种神经网络模型，系统地改变模型架构与数据分布特征，并通过表示分析、注意力分析及因果中介分析等方法评估各因素对符号机制涌现的影响。结果表明，尽管基于Transformer的模型在任务中成功发展出符号机制，但更关键的是数据多样性——在多个数据多样性维度上，更高的数据多样性显著增强了符号特征的表达强度。更为重要的是，即使在经过修改的Transformer架构甚至多层感知机（Multilayer Perceptron, MLP）中也观察到相同的符号机制，说明模型架构中的归纳偏置（inductive biases）并非必要条件。此外，在实体-属性绑定任务中亦呈现出一致规律。综上，研究揭示了数据多样性是推动神经网络中符号计算能力涌现的主要因素，而非模型架构本身。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13270
作者: Melody Zixuan Li,Taylor Webb
机构: Princeton Neuroscience Institute(普林斯顿神经科学研究所); Princeton University(普林斯顿大学); Department of Psychology(心理学系)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 15 figures, 5 appendices. To appear at NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent work has identified a set of emergent symbolic mechanisms that support abstract reasoning in large language models, but it remains unclear what factors drive the emergence of these mechanisms. To address this question, we trained neural networks from scratch on abstract sequence tasks, varying both architectural and data distributional factors, and investigated the effects of these factors on the emergence of symbolic mechanisms. Using representational, attentional, and causal mediation analyses, we first confirmed that transformer-based language models trained from scratch on our task developed symbolic mechanisms. We then found that, across multiple axes of data diversity, greater diversity produced stronger symbolic signatures. Surprisingly, the same signatures emerged in modified transformer architectures and even multilayer perceptrons, indicating that architectural inductive biases are not necessary for the development of symbolic mechanisms. We also observed consistent patterns in an entity-attribute binding task. Together, these findings identify data diversity, not architecture, as the primary driver of emergent symbolic computation in neural networks.

[NLP-67] Domain-Routed Delta Optimization for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多教师在线蒸馏（Multi-teacher on-policy distillation, MOPD）中因共享学生参数更新而导致的领域特异性知识保留不足的问题。传统方法为每个样本分配一个领域教师，但所有样本共同更新同一组共享的学生参数，导致不同领域间的优化方向相互干扰，损害了原始专家模型（expert model）的几何结构保持能力。本文提出的领域路由增量优化（Domain-Routed Delta Optimization, DRD-MOPD） 的关键在于：明确指定每个领域样本所更新的学生参数组件，通过将学生模型分解为一个冻结的基础部分（frozen base）和一组从“专家减去基础”权重初始化的可训练组件，使各组件在前向传播中均参与计算，并支持四种独立的更新模式，每种模式具有独立的优化器状态。该设计确保了各领域知识在参数空间中的解耦更新，从而有效保留原始专家方向的几何特性。实验表明，与此前工作Open-MOPD相比，本方法在20次更新后仍能保持沿各组件原始方向的投影系数接近1，成对角度维持在88.04至92.41度之间，且增量能量中仅有4.90%位于原始专家方向之外（相较其他方法显著降低），同时在六项基准测试上实现32.72%的宏平均得分，优于初始任务算术融合结果（32.44%），充分验证了其在几何保真度与模型性能上的双重优势。

作者: Lin Yao
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Zhongguancun Academy (中关村学院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-teacher on-policy distillation assigns each sample a domain teacher but typically updates shared student parameters. We introduce Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain’s samples update. The student is the sum of a frozen base and trainable components initialized from expert-minus-base weights. All components participate in every forward pass; four update modes define the correspondence between sample domains and components, each with independent optimizer states. We analyze these update rules and measure retention of the original expert geometry through angles, projection coefficients, and energy. Prior work such as Open-MOPD distills directly from the base model; 97.02% of its released final checkpoint’s increment energy lies outside the span of the original expert directions. In comparison, our Own checkpoint after 20 updates retains coefficients near one along each component’s original direction and pairwise angles ranging from 88.04 to 92.41 degrees; its exported BF16 student’s increment has 4.90% outside energy, versus 10.52% for the sum of saved FP32 components. The same checkpoint achieves a 32.72% macro score across six benchmarks, compared with 32.44% for its initial task-arithmetic merge. These measurements describe geometry and capability at the evaluated training stages and settings.

[NLP-68] Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement across Seven Open Reasoning Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多轮工具调用（multi-turn tool calling）场景中推理历史（reasoning history）被删除所带来的不可见成本问题。在实际应用中，73%的用户交互跨越多个回合，而上游服务提供方会将每条推理轨迹与发起者绑定，导致请求跨服务商传递时历史信息被清除，但这一清除操作所带来的性能影响尚未被量化测量。本文首次通过盲测、多种子、三类渲染条件、七种开源权重推理模型、三个种子、794个任务及官方验证器，实现了对完整推理历史删除行为的直接测量。结果表明，删除操作对任务表现的影响范围为-4.4至+51.3分，且两端均不包含零，说明其影响显著且方向不确定；对于同一模型在0%到100%删除率之间重新配置的情况，性能变化不超过1.5分，表明删除敏感性（deletion sensitivity）是模型层面的固有属性。该属性具有可重复性：模型在不同部署环境下表现一致，仅需两次运行（一次保留、一次删除）即可完成评估，因此应作为路由和聚合阶段的先验信息进行显式建模，而非作为隐含默认成本忽略。解决方案的关键在于识别并量化“删除敏感性”这一模型级特性，并将其纳入系统设计的显式考量，从而实现对推理链中断影响的精准评估与优化。

作者: Hanzhang Jia,Liheng Zeng,Zhiyu Yang,Yi Gao,Bo Ma
机构: University of Sussex (英国萨塞克斯大学); Zhejiang Gongshang University (浙江工商大学); Chang’an University (长安大学); Shanghai Shuyuan Information Technology Co., Ltd. (上海书源信息技术有限公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning models write a reasoning trace at every turn of a multi-turn tool session, and later turns read this history. Across 94k ShareGPT conversations, 73 percent of user interactions span multiple turns. Upstream providers bind each trace to its issuer, so a request forwarded across issuers arrives with its history deleted, and the task cost of this stripping remains unmeasured. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling, through three rendering conditions, seven open-weight reasoning models, three seeds, 794 tasks, and the official checker. The same deletion spans -4.4 to +51.3 points with both ends excluding zero, and for the one model re-dosed from 0 to 100 percent deletion, the reading varies by at most 1.5 points. Deletion sensitivity is a model-level property. The reading follows the model itself and stays constant across deployments, and a retrained or re-released model is a new model that a two-cell screen, one retention run and one deletion run, re-reads for the cost of two runs. Deletion sensitivity is thus a measurable property of the model, and the reading must enter routing and aggregation as prior information rather than persist as an invisible default cost.

[NLP-69] Latin American Studies since the 1980s: From Apocalyptic Dreams to Assimilationist Consolidation

【速读】： 该论文旨在探讨拉丁美洲研究（Latin American Studies, LAS）自1982年以来在三大主流期刊中的演变路径，重点分析其学科定位、作者构成及引用模式的变迁。研究发现，拉斯经历了同化式整合（assimilationist consolidation），即该领域已形成相对稳定的学术制度化结构，核心期刊在学科网络中占据枢纽地位，并成为跨学科交流的桥梁。然而，这种整合强化了以英语学术规范为核心的等级体系，导致原属核心的拉美本土期刊被边缘化，尽管拉美作者占比有所上升，其学术表达与研究范式却日益趋近北方（盎格鲁-撒克逊）学术标准，反映出知识生产中的权力不平等格局。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13216
作者: Thiago Dumont Oliveira,Juan Grigera,Pedro Mendes Loureiro
机构: 未知
类目: Digital Libraries (cs.DL); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We investigate how Latin American Studies (LAS) has evolved since 1982 in three leading LAS journals. Using network analysis, text mining, and bibliometrics, we trace transformations in disciplinary positioning, authorship, and citation patterns. Our main claim is that LAS has undergone an assimilationist consolidation. The field is now institutionally recognisable, with core LAS journals occupying central positions in disciplinary networks and acting as bridges across fields. Yet this consolidation has reinforced hierarchies privileging Anglophone academic norms. Journals based in Latin America, once central, have been marginalised. The share of Latin American authors has grown, but their profiles converge towards Northern standards.

[NLP-70] HiCAP: Hierarchical Cultural Adaptation via Personality for Dialogue Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话系统在跨文化语境下生成符合特定文化语言规范与社会期待回应时，忽视个体人格特质对文化表达和沟通风格影响的问题。现有方法通常仅关注文化层面的适配，未能充分建模人格因素如何塑造交流行为。为此，论文提出一种名为HiCAP（Hierarchical Cultural and Personality-aware Dialogue Framework）的新框架，其核心在于将人格特质融入文化自适应对话生成过程。关键创新在于采用分层式人格条件控制机制：首先根据目标文化的语调基调对响应风格进行对齐，再基于个体人格属性进一步精细化语言表达与内容生成。为实现这一目标，模型结合监督微调与基于指令的调优策略，并引入动态指令模板及多智能体示范，以捕捉文化与人格之间的多样化组合。在CulturalPersonas与CPED数据集上的实验表明，HiCAP在多项对话生成指标上均取得最优表现，验证了其在文化适应性与人格建模方面的有效性。

作者: Lingzhi Shen,Xiaohao Cai,Yunfei Long,Imran Razzak,Shoaib Jameel
机构: University of Southampton (南安普顿大学); Queen Mary University of London (伦敦玛丽女王大学); Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cultural adaptation in dialogue systems refers to the ability to generate responses that conform to linguistic norms and social expectations across different cultures. However, existing dialogue generation approaches pay limited attention to the role of personality in shaping cultural expression and communication style. We therefore propose HiCAP, a novel framework that integrates personality traits into culturally adaptive dialogue generation. HiCAP employs a personality-conditioned control mechanism that hierarchically modulates response style by first aligning it with the cultural tone and then refining linguistic expression and content according to individual personality attributes. To embed these factors, the model combines supervised fine-tuning and instruction-based tuning, supported by dynamic instruction templates and multi-agent demonstrations to capture diverse combinations of culture and personality. Experiments on CulturalPersonas and CPED show that HiCAP achieves the strongest overall performance across various dialogue generation metrics, demonstrating effective cultural adaptability and personality modelling.

[NLP-71] One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模模型中混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）层在推理阶段因专家并行（Expert Parallelism, EP）导致的通信开销问题。在推理场景下，每个GPU处理的令牌数量较少，且批量大小较小，因此固定开销（如通信初始化、元数据交换等）不再随令牌数量线性增长，反而成为延迟的主要瓶颈。现有方案如DeepEP依赖于双向的all-to-all通信，需进行频繁的元数据交换和数据复制，造成显著性能损耗。为此，论文提出NVLinkOneSided——一种基于单边通信（one-sided communication）的EP all-to-all机制，其核心创新在于：源端秩（source rank）直接将令牌推送至目标GPU的秩主导（rank-major）缓冲区，无需预先交换元数据；同时，分组矩阵乘法（grouped GEMMs）可直接从这些缓冲区读取数据，避免了为每个专家单独复制数据的开销。为满足不同场景需求，论文设计了两种同步协议：适用于高吞吐场景的Fence协议和适用于低延迟场景的Sentinel协议。实验结果表明，在Blackwell GPU上，NVLinkOneSided在小批量情况下比DeepEP快1.2–3.0倍，整体MoE层性能最高提升2.4倍，甚至在每GPU最多128个令牌时超越融合式DeepGEMM MegaMoE，展现出对解码任务的竞争力。此外，该方案通过模块化接口实现与激活量化格式解耦，兼容多种计算后端，易于集成到主流推理框架中。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13188
作者: Bo Li,Chulian Zhang,Or Biri,Anthony Chang,Anton Korzh,Noam Duvdevani,XingFei Xi,Daniel Stokes,Zhenhuan Chen,Ludwig Schneider,Artem Y. Polyakov,Julien Demouth,Chandler Zhou
机构: 未知
类目: Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Performance (cs.PF)
备注: 19 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Expert parallelism (EP) shards the experts of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer across GPUs, so every MoE layer requires two all-to-all communications, namely dispatch and combine. Compared with training, inference processes relatively few tokens per GPU at a time, and at small batch sizes fixed costs that do not grow with the number of tokens, rather than data movement, dominate the latency. We present NVLinkOneSided, a one-sided EP all-to-all for GPUs within a single NVLink domain. Each source rank pushes its tokens, without first exchanging metadata, into rank-major buffers on the target GPUs, and the grouped GEMMs read them in place instead of from a per-expert copy. We provide two protocols for the synchronization that the communication requires, namely Fence and Sentinel, for high-throughput and low-latency scenarios respectively. On Blackwell GPUs, NVLinkOneSided completes dispatch and combine 1.2-3.0 \times faster than DeepEP, with the largest speedups at small batch sizes. The resulting MoE layer is up to 2.4 \times faster than DeepEP with DeepGEMM. It even outperforms the fused DeepGEMM MegaMoE at up to 128 tokens per GPU, making it still competitive for decoding. We expose NVLinkOneSided through a modular interface, so that it is agnostic to the activation quantization format, decoupled from the MoE compute backend and easy to integrate into inference frameworks.

[NLP-72] Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason : Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在推理过程中错误分类的可靠性问题，特别是针对“组合性坍缩”（Compositional Collapse）这一错误类别。研究发现，当前主流的失败模式分类方法存在严重依赖测量过程的问题：同一错误在不同分类顺序下可能被归入不同类别，导致报告的错误分布具有高度主观性和不稳定性。其解决方案的关键在于揭示并量化这种测量偏差——通过在多语言数学基准上对12个模型进行系统测试，发现50.1%的错误同时符合多个类别，且分类结果随判断顺序显著变化（在六种排序中，“组合性坍缩”的占比跨度达26.4%至76.4%）。此外，人工评估者与模型分类器在“组合性坍缩”判别上一致性极低（kappa = 0.093），而对任务正确性的判断则高度一致（kappa = 0.932），表明该类别定义受提示工程影响显著。进一步分析显示，模型标签与人类标注差异主要源于提示设计而非模型本身，当排除一个有缺陷的基准样本后，两者差距大幅缩小。因此，论文提出四项低成本验证措施以提升错误分析的可信度：报告标签共现情况、交换分类器判断顺序以检验鲁棒性、使用共享独立样本进行验证，以及审计系统性分歧。

作者: Madhu Sudhan Rao Beesetty
机构: PayPal, Inc.(PayPal)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 11 pages. Accepted at IEEE CogMI 2026 (regular paper)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Failure taxonomies for LLM reasoning are increasingly reported as measurements: papers state what fraction of a model’s errors fall into named categories, then compare those fractions across models. We show that for one such category the reported fraction is largely a property of the measurement procedure. We defined Compositional Collapse (a model notices a required sub-part of a problem, then drops or misapplies it) and measured it across twelve models and eleven languages on a public multilingual math benchmark (2,316 graded records). First, 50.1% of failures carry evidence for more than one category, so the reported plurality depends on the order in which the classifier tests them: reversing two tests moves it in eleven of twelve models, and across all six orderings Collapse’s share spans 26.4% to 76.4%. Second, agreement collapses for the category but not for the task. Native speakers of all eleven languages judged 179 transcripts, agreeing with our inspector at kappa = 0.932 on answer correctness but only kappa = 0.093 on Collapse. A second native speaker per language re-rated 142 items; on 121 determinate pairs the two humans agree with each other at kappa = 0.659, while each agrees with the inspector at kappa = 0.094. Re-running the same inspector model with the human instructions verbatim raises kappa against Human 2 from 0.147 to 0.636, so the gap is largely attributable to the prompt, not the model. Third, the inspector labels Collapse 1.81 times as often as native speakers, but only 1.17 times once a defective benchmark item (a deleted clause in the Bengali and Chinese translations) is excluded. We recommend four cheap checks before comparing failure-mode rates across models: report label co-occurrence, permute the tie-break, validate on a shared independent sample, and audit systematic disagreements.

[NLP-73] Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多轮工具使用智能体在在线蒸馏（On-policy Distillation, OPD）过程中因训练-推理分布不匹配导致的性能下降问题，尤其针对成功轨迹选择不当可能引入误导性监督的挑战。其核心解决方案是将成功参考轨迹的选择建模为无目标最优传输（free-target optimal transport）问题，通过最大化失败轨迹与成功轨迹之间的兼容性来实现最优匹配。由于潜在状态路径不可观测，论文提出以动作序列对齐作为兼容性的可观测代理，并采用最长公共子序列（Longest Common Subsequence, LCS）方法，识别出动作序列中共享的有序主干结构，同时允许可恢复的偏离路径，从而有效衡量轨迹间的兼容性。这一视角使轨迹兼容性成为多轮OPD中参考轨迹选择的核心标准。实验结果表明，在ALFWorld和τ³-bench的航空领域任务上，LCS是唯一能在整体得分及所有三项航空指标上均优于无参考OPD的方法；且未经进一步优化，基于航空领域训练的模型在零售领域迁移时，LCS同样显著提升各项指标，验证了该方法的泛化能力与有效性。

Abstract:On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of \tau^3 -bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. Without further optimization, the airline-trained models also transfer to the retail domain, where LCS improves all three metrics.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决非线性系统辨识中依赖专家经验、模型选择与物理先验知识融合困难以及模型验证不充分等问题。其提出的ASPIRE框架通过引入大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理，实现从测量数据中自动构建闭式、非线性静态或动态模型，支持以形式化或自然语言表达的系统描述、模型用途及物理约束条件。解决方案的关键在于：利用大语言模型代理自主决策辨识方法，执行建模流程，并生成包含参数、估计记录、项解释及在不可见测试数据上评估误差的完整可解释模型；同时，对形式化物理要求进行独立验证，并支持人机交互式迭代优化。实验在移动机器人、带干摩擦的旋转系统和实验室发酵罐三个真实系统上验证，共30次运行均成功产出有效模型，成本为每轮0.96至3.38美元，且人工评估显示模型解释与结构选择文档在150项评估指标中完全满足132项，部分满足18项，主要偏差源于模型结构选择依据的不准确或缺乏支持。

Abstract:System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method. ASPIRE constructs closed-form, nonlinear static or dynamic models from measured data, optionally supplemented by a system description, the intended use of the model, and physical requirements expressed formally or in natural language. Each model includes its parameters, an estimation record, an interpretation of its terms, and an error evaluated on test data inaccessible to the agent. Formal physical requirements are verified independently. ASPIRE operates autonomously or interactively, allowing the agent to ask questions and the user to request further analyses and identification rounds. We evaluate ASPIRE on three measured systems: a mobile robot, a rotational system with dry friction, and a laboratory fermenter. Each system is tested with and without a description, in five runs per task. All 30 runs delivered valid models, at a cost of 0.96 to 3.38 US dollars per run. An assessment by the authors found that, for the 30 models recommended by the agent, one per run, the interpretation of the model and the documentation of its structure selection and parameter estimation fully satisfied 132 of 150 assessed items and partly satisfied 18. The most frequent discrepancy, found in nine models, concerned inaccurate or unsupported claims about model structure selection.

[NLP-75] Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在数学、科学与工程任务中因推理过程中的错误而产生“错误传播”问题，即模型在某一步骤出现错误后仍持续生成无效内容，导致资源浪费且难以察觉。现有解决方案要么仅在最终答案阶段进行验证并重新开始推理，要么依赖于需要大量计算资源的验证型大模型（verifier LLM），造成显存竞争和响应延迟。本文提出一种在线、确定性验证机制：利用代码可执行性对多种推理步骤进行实时验证，无需调用任何模型或使用GPU，在推理过程中即时完成校验。一旦检测到错误，系统立即定位问题并允许模型从该点继续推理。该方法在符号数学任务中得到验证，其推导过程天然包含可被计算机代数系统（Computer Algebra System, CAS）毫秒级检查的显式表达式。在ASyMoB基准测试中，针对三款开源权重模型，该方法将准确率提升1.4至5.6个百分点，对应错误答案减少1.8%至14.9%，同时仅增加6%-7%的令牌消耗。由于验证器与主模型完全解耦，该方案不与模型发展竞争资源，反而能随确定性校验能力扩展至更多推理类型而持续增强效果，具有良好的兼容性与可扩展性。

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted with mathematical, scientific and engineering work, yet their mistakes are often confidently written and hard to spot. A single wrong step tends to propagate, making the model waste inference tokens following a false premise. Existing safeguards either check only the final answer and restart from scratch, or rely on a verifier LLM that competes for GPU capacity and slows down response time. We propose online, deterministic verification: many kinds of reasoning steps can be validated by code, so a step can be verified in real time, as it is written, without any model call or GPU use. Whenever a check fails, we point out the mistake and let the model continue from the same spot. We demonstrate this approach on symbolic mathematics, where derivations already contain explicit expressions that a computer algebra system can check in milliseconds. Tested on the ASyMoB benchmark with three open-weights models, our online validation improves accuracy by 1.4-5.6 percentage points, corresponding to a 1.8-14.9% net reduction in incorrect answers, while increasing token usage by only 6-7%. Because the verifier is independent of the model, the approach complements progress in LLMs rather than competing with it: every new model can benefit immediately, and the benefit grows as deterministic checkers extend to more kinds of reasoning steps.

[NLP-76] One Temperature to Rule Them All? NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在推理阶段采样过程中温度参数设置的优化问题，具体聚焦于在标准pass@K评估范式下，多温度采样（multi-temperature sampling）相较于单温度采样（single-temperature sampling）的实际收益边界。其核心问题是：在何种条件下，通过动态调整采样温度以实现温度多样性能够提升性能；而在何种情况下，仅使用一个经过调优的固定温度已足够。解决方案的关键在于提出一种高效计算理论上最优多温度分配方案的方法，并通过分析多个模型与数据集上的逐题成功概率随温度变化的分布特性，发现高难度问题更难以共享最优采样温度，但该趋势仅为硬度的对数级关系。进一步地，论文揭示了“钝化效应”（dulling effects）这一数学机制——即温度选择对不同问题分布具有鲁棒性，从而解释了为何在将温度作为采样预算K的函数进行调优时，多温度策略相对于单温度基线所能带来的性能增益通常有限。研究结果明确了多温度采样的适用场景，并为温度的合理设定提供了理论指导。

Abstract:Inference-time sampling is a central mechanism for improving large language models, with temperature controlling the tradeoff between reliability and diversity. While recent work suggests that varying temperature across samples can improve multi-sample inference, simple fixed-temperature schemes remain the standard in practice. We investigate this discrepancy in the canonical pass@K setting, asking when temperature diversity is useful, and when a single tuned temperature suffices. To this end, we analyze per-question success probabilities across multiple models and datasets, tracking how they vary with sampling temperature. We identify several consistent properties of these profiles, including that harder questions are less likely to share efficient sampling temperatures, although this trend is only logarithmic in hardness. We then derive an efficient method for evaluating the theoretically optimal multi-temperature allocation scheme, and show that although such a scheme improves performance, its gains over single-temperature baselines are typically modest when temperature is tuned as a function of the sampling budget K. We explain this phenomenon through mathematical mechanisms that we call dulling effects, and show how they ensure the robustness of temperature choices across different question distributions. Our results clarify when multi-temperature sampling is useful, and how temperatures should ideally be chosen.

[NLP-77] he Left Ripple of Byte-Pair Encoding: Certified Lookbehind for Every Dictionary

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决字节对编码（Byte Pair Encoding, BPE）中前缀字符串对分词结果影响范围的理论边界问题，具体包括：左端添加字符串所能引起的分词变化最大距离（即“起源半径”）、哪些词典会导致该影响无限扩展、以及在有限情况下是否可高效计算。其核心解决方案在于提出“半径证书”（radius certificates）机制，通过构建自动机的两次运行来判断起源半径——一次推测最终分词结构，从而在多项式时间内确定任意词典下的起源半径是否有限。研究发现，起源半径为无穷当且仅当存在一个周期性词串具有两个无共同边界的规范铺砌（canonical tiling），在排序条件下等价于某规则 (t, t) 在自身阶段即出现两个副本相邻的情况，此类规则必然使词典具有无限起源半径。有限起源半径意味着任意宽度窗口内均存在“切割点”（cut），且该性质成立当且仅当这些切割点稠密。此外，论文证明了所有词典下分词过程均为可顺序化（subsequential），并构造出一种流式分词器（streaming tokenizer），可在每读入一个符号后以多项式时间输出当前不可被后续字符改变的确定性分词结果，回应了Dalirrooyfard和Ye提出的问题。同时，标签度量（label measure）——即分词序列间的编辑距离——的有界性也可在多项式时间内判定；在排序条件下，单次编辑所引发的最大距离随规则数 $ m $ 的渐近范围介于 $ m^2/10 $ 到 $ m^2/2 $ 之间。实验表明，GPT-2的合并表包含244个有效自配对规则，使其从第42次合并起起源半径趋于无穷；而cl100k、o200k及Llama 3则从初始阶段即具备无限起源半径。所有数值结果均可由程序直接输出，未被执行的部分则被明确命名。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Berglund and van der Merwe formalized byte-pair encoding and bounded how far an appended string can change a tokenization, leaving the converse open: how far can a string prepended on the left change it, which dictionaries make that ripple infinite, and can it be computed efficiently when finite? We answer all three for every dictionary. The origin radius, how far a prepend can change covering spans, is decided with radius certificates by a product of two runs of the automaton that guesses the final tokens, in time polynomial in the dictionary written out, and it is infinite exactly when one periodic word has two canonical tilings with no common boundary. Under their ordering condition it is infinite exactly when some rule (t, t) finds its two copies adjacent at its own stage, and such a rule makes any dictionary infinite. A finite radius makes every window of a width read off the radii have a cut, and the radius is finite exactly when such cuts are dense. The token machine completes for every dictionary, and the tokenization is subsequential, extending what Berglund, Martens and van der Merwe proved for proper ones under one pass per rule. A streaming tokenizer emits after every symbol exactly the tokens that no continuation changes, in polynomial time, answering a question of Dalirrooyfard and Ye. Boundedness of the label measure, the edit distance of the token sequences, is decided for every dictionary in polynomial time as well, and under the ordering condition the largest distance one edit causes over dictionaries of m rules lies asymptotically between m^2/10 and m^2/2. GPT-2’s merge table carries 244 effective self-pairs, so its origin radius is infinite from the forty-second merge on, and that of cl100k, o200k and Llama 3 from their first. Every measured number is its program’s output, and what is not executed is named.

Abstract:Languages of India need 1.6 to 14 times as many tokens as English on GPT-4o’s tokenizer for the same content, which makes them more expensive and slower to serve. We train tokenizers from scratch on human-written text in about 200 languages. Havon v3 is a byte-level BPE tokenizer with 262,144 tokens and a pre-tokenizer that keeps combining marks with their letters and chunks scripts written without spaces. On FLORES-200 devtest it needs fewer tokens than GPT-4o’s o200k_base on all 25 languages of India (median 0.74 of GPT-4o’s count) and on 172 of 204 languages, but 7% more on English. Havon v4 adds a second, multi-word training stage (SuperBPE) to v3. At exactly GPT-4o’s vocabulary size of 200,019 tokens, v4 needs 6.1% fewer tokens than GPT-4o on English and fewer on 161 of 204 languages and all 25 languages of India (median 0.74); at the same size, v3 needs 9.4% more on English and wins on 133. With 262,144 tokens, v4 needs 9.6% fewer tokens on English and fewer on 182 of 204 languages, and with 524,288 tokens it needs fewer on 203 of 204. The gains are largest for English, Hindi and the Romance languages; scripts without spaces, such as Khmer, Burmese and Tibetan, gain little and lose subword merges. Havon v5 replaces v4’s Python-only code sample with permissively licensed code in 15 languages: on code it needs 1.03 to 1.22 times GPT-4o’s tokens, against 1.11 to 1.29 for v4, while keeping all 25 languages of India (median 0.74, all significant under a sentence-level bootstrap) and English (0.94). These are compression results only: we have not yet evaluated a model trained with v4 or v5.

Abstract:Commercial language model APIs bill per token, so a tokenizer that needs more tokens for the same content in one language makes that language more expensive, slower, and able to fit less text in a fixed context window. We measure this disparity for nine public tokenizers, including those of GPT-4, GPT-4o, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-V3, Mistral-Nemo and four Sarvam models, on all 25 languages of India available in FLORES-200 (2,009 professionally translated sentences aligned with English) and on 13,732 human-translated Hinglish-English social media pairs from PHINC. On GPT-4o’s tokenizer the same content needs between 1.57 times (Hindi) and 5.01 times (Odia) the tokens of English, and 13.7 times for Santali in Ol Chiki script; GPT-4’s tokenizer needs up to 12.8 times. Sarvam-30B/105B is the only third-party tokenizer that stays below 2.6 times on every language (median 1.53). In an illustrative scenario using official list prices accessed on 5 November 2026 and stated assumptions, a support bot handling 100,000 chats a month on GPT-4o would cost about INR 56,640 in English and INR 102,829 in Marathi; these are estimates, not measured production costs. Against an openly licensed Hindi and Marathi morphological segmentation set, no tokenizer places more than 35% of its word-internal boundaries on morpheme boundaries (boundary F1 at most 0.48). In a companion paper we present a tokenizer that reduces this tax. Code, pinned artifacts and raw token counts are available at this https URL.

[NLP-80] GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在高质量、复杂交互的3A游戏（如《GTA V》）中评估智能体感知、推理与控制能力的难题，尤其针对任务完成情况难以自动化验证的问题，这限制了强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）在真实场景中的应用。其核心解决方案是提出GTAGym——一个面向《GTA V》任务的评估环境与框架，包含基于主线剧情重构的103个在线任务（涵盖九类任务类型）以及47个基于图像的射击/狙击任务，构成名为GTAVBench的评测基准。该系统通过网络服务器提供对游戏环境的远程访问，支持通过截图和键盘鼠标输入实现并行测试，并结合自动引擎状态检测实现任务结果的精准判定。为提升评估效率，还设计了GTAVBench-AGI分支，仅在首张截图中提供指令，由智能体自动生成交互历史压缩，以更贴近通用人工智能（AGI）的评估范式。实验表明，最优配置下大语言模型（LLM）在GTAVBench-AGI上的综合准确率达70.9%，但在空中导航、规避与拦截等复杂行为上仍存在挑战。此外，GTAGym集成了可扩展的任务生成器，基于预设模板和参数范围自动生成大量三维导航及图像射击任务环境，支持自动奖励与终止信号，显著提升了训练效率；通过LoRA微调的Qwen3.8-27B模型在生成的步行导航任务上实现了域内性能提升，并成功迁移至域外任务类别，使《GTA V》原生任务的成功率从15%提高至23%。因此，该研究的关键突破在于构建了一个兼具高保真度、自动化评估与可扩展生成能力的综合性评测与训练平台，为复杂环境下的智能体学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract:AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.

[NLP-81] Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agent ic Software Development

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决编码代理在处理含视觉缺陷的用户界面（UI）截图时，因图像质量下降（如低分辨率、压缩伪影或小字号文本）而导致无法准确识别相关UI元素及对应源文件的问题。现有方法中，视觉-语言模型在图像质量恶化时可靠性下降，而依赖光学字符识别（OCR）的方法则可能将输入中的识别错误传递至后续分析，尤其当目标视觉证据在查询截图中已不清晰时，二者均面临显著局限。为此，本文提出一种关键解决方案：为编码代理引入由代码仓库生成的高保真参考图像（repository-rendered reference images），即基于待修改代码库实时渲染的清晰界面截图。这些参考图像保留了当前潜在存在缺陷的实现状态，同时提供可读性强的视觉证据，且无需依赖已知无错版本，可自动构建并实现可复现的应用状态。实验在基于SWE-bench Multimodal构建的受控基准上进行，通过向真实网页应用注入视觉缺陷，并系统性地改变截图质量与参考图像供给情况，评估编码代理对源文件的定位能力。结果表明，参考图像显著提升了在图像退化条件下的文件定位准确率，尤其在四倍降采样与JPEG压缩下表现突出；进一步分析显示，在相同退化条件下，该方法的文本识别准确率比偏向语言模型的OCR高出约12个百分点。

Abstract:Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application’s UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.

[NLP-82] khammoon: From a Linguistic Guideline to a Thai Morpheme Segmenter

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决泰语自然语言处理中因缺乏统一的词边界定义而导致的分词歧义问题。由于泰语书写无空格，传统分词工具依赖于特定语料库（如BEST）中的词级惯例，而这些惯例在面对具有生成性的复合构词时表现不佳，产生任意且模糊的边界划分。其解决方案的关键在于从词级分词转向形态学层级的分词，聚焦于“khammoon”——即承载意义的最小语义原子单位。通过在形态层面进行分词，可获得明确且一致的形态表示，从根本上消除复合构词带来的歧义。该方法不仅提升了语言学一致性，还显著改善了下游任务的表示质量：基于形态单元训练的模型在词性标注、命名实体识别和情感分类等任务上达到或超越词级基线性能，证明了形态一致性对表示学习的正向作用。为实现这一目标，研究团队将语言学原则形式化为具有极高人类一致性（κ ≈ 0.99）的决策指南，结合大语言模型（LLM）进行规模化标注，并利用人工标注校正系统性错误；最终构建了一个轻量级（100万参数）、专用于高效CPU推理的卷积双向长短期记忆（convolutional BiLSTM）分词器——khammoon，其在跨域文本上的边界F1得分高达0.992。相关决策指南、数据集、模型及代码库均已公开发布。

Abstract:Thai is written without spaces between words, making segmentation a foundational step in most Thai NLP pipelines. Existing tools primarily reproduce the word-level conventions of corpora such as BEST; however, because the notion of a “word” in Thai lacks a unified linguistic consensus, these conventions struggle with productive compounding, leading to arbitrary boundaries and ambiguity in downstream representations. Instead, we propose operating at the morphological level, focusing on khammoon, the smallest atomic unit that carries meaning. Segmenting at the morphemic level provides an explicit, consistent morphological representation that eliminates compounding ambiguity. Crucially, this representation benefits downstream learning: models trained on morphemes perform on par with or exceed word-level baselines across part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, and sentiment classification, demonstrating that linguistic consistency improves representation quality without downstream performance penalty. To operationalize this representation, we translate linguistic principles into a formal decision guideline with near-perfect human agreement ( \kappa \approx 0.99 ), scale annotation with an LLM, and correct systematic errors with human labels. Finally, we train khammoon, a lightweight 1M-parameter convolutional BiLSTM segmenter designed for efficient CPU inference, achieving a boundary F1 of 0.992 on out-of-domain text. The guideline, datasets, model, and library are all publicly released.

[NLP-83] Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医学视觉-语言模型（Medical VLMs）在诊断推理中存在“命名即发现”（name-to-find）的偏差问题，即模型仅因问题中提及某病灶名称便声称其存在，而忽视图像实际证据的情况。现有标准基准测试无法有效识别此类虚假关联，导致模型性能评估失真。为解决此问题，研究提出构建无须人工标注的反事实视图（counterfactual views），包括通过图像修复（inpainting）擦除病灶、在相同形状位置进行控制性编辑以及未修改的无病灶图像。核心解决方案是引入证据敏感性差距（Evidence Sensitivity Gap, ESG），量化模型在病灶被擦除后与控制性编辑后回答“不存在”或“不相关”的比例差异；若模型真正依赖图像证据，则ESG应显著高于零。实验表明，基于标签轨迹训练的MedScope-4B（Qwen3.5-4B，LoRA，图像工具）在五类影像数据上实现ESG 0.758，远超前沿模型（0.27–0.47），且对真实病灶的检测准确率未明显下降。关键创新在于：通过在训练中纳入擦除与编辑后的图像，使小模型获得“证据门控”（evidence-gated）的推理倾向，这种能力无法仅通过提示工程（prompting）实现，但并不提升感知能力，且仍需关注罕见关键病灶的覆盖。

作者: Bhaskar Gurram
机构: 独立研究者(Independent Researcher)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this. From public segmentation datasets we build counterfactual views without manual annotation: the lesion erased by inpainting, a same-shape control edit elsewhere, and unedited lesion-free images. The evidence sensitivity gap (ESG) is the rate of absent-or-refer answers after erasure minus the rate after the control edit; it is zero for a model that ignores the image or reacts to both edits alike. MedScope-4B (Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA, image tools) was trained on label-derived trajectories, selected by a pre-registered rule and tested once against nine frontier and six open VLMs; four pre-registered checks then probed the mechanism. On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions. Without counterfactual views ESG fell to 0.279±0.107 (three seeds); the effect replicated on MedGemma 1.5 4B and two unseen inpainting tools. At four external centres the advantage held but frontier models detected more real lesions; on a fresh external test MedScope-4B detected 0 of 48 pneumothorax films, with net utility below gemini-4-argon’s (-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]). Matching the control edit was not shown to matter; over three seeds no fresh-external ESG advantage over removal-based DPO was established; a paired-view consistency objective did not beat a matched-compute control, while that continuation alone cut erased-lesion claims on unseen tools at every seed, at a cost in sensitivity at one. Training on erased and edited images gives a small model an evidence-gated disposition that prompting does not give frontier models; it does not improve perception, and rare critical findings need coverage.

[NLP-84] Linear Probes to Bayesian Manifolds: Geometry of Arithmetic in Large Language Models ICLR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能（Generative AI）模型中线性探针（linear probe）研究存在的根本性问题：仅凭探针准确率无法有效区分模型实际计算所依赖的几何结构与潜在混淆因素。现有方法将四个独立但常被混同的科学主张——可解码性（decodability）、形状（shape）、归属性（ownership）和因果使用性（causal use）——合并为单一的准确率指标，导致结论易被误读。为此，作者提出一个四阶段贝叶斯分析框架，分别对上述四项主张进行独立验证：阶段2通过贝叶斯证据比较候选几何形状并筛选最优解；阶段3通过移除预设相关概念以检验目标形状是否真正归属于所探查概念而非继承自其他概念；阶段4则对形状实施干预，检验其输出影响的因果作用。在GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B和Pythia 6.9B等模型上对两位数加法与乘法任务的应用表明，尽管几乎所有概念均可解码，但解码方向在不同概念间高度重叠；多数支持性比较结果指向“变半径螺旋”（ribbon）或“环面”（torus）等复杂几何结构；在1,330个具有归属判断的神经元中，仅有19%的形状具有独占归属性，81%为继承性；而无论归属与否，干预形状均能产生与全维探针相当的输出影响（约保留61%效果），且仅需最多五个维度，显著低于探针本身的九维中位数。因此，该研究的关键贡献在于揭示了传统探针结果的过度乐观倾向，并主张未来应将探针分析报告为对四项核心主张的独立判决，而非单一准确率，从而提升对模型内部表征机制理解的严谨性与可信度。

作者: Anshul Kumar,Neha Prasad,Manoj Kumar,Barnabás Póczos,Deeksha Varshney
机构: Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学); Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (印度理工学院乔德普尔分校); Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (印度理工学院鲁尔基分校)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Linear probes are a standard method to study geometric structures, such as helices and circles, from the activations of large language models (LLMs), and such structure is often taken as evidence that the model computes with it. Probe accuracy alone cannot establish this, because it conflates four separate claims. These are (1) that the concept is decodable from the activations, (2) that they form a specific shape, (3) that the shape belongs to the probed concept rather than to a related concept the model also represents, and (4) that the output of the model depends on the shape. We call these claims decodability, shape, ownership, and causal use, and we test them separately with a four-stage Bayesian pipeline. Stage 2 compares candidate shapes and selects the best one only when its evidence passes a predefined threshold. Stage 3 removes a set of related concepts, specified in advance, and tests whether the shape is owned or inherited. Stage 4 intervenes on the shape to test whether the output of the model depends on it. We apply the pipeline to two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Pythia 6.9B. Nearly every concept is decodable, but the decoded directions overlap substantially across concepts. Every strongly supported comparison selects a ribbon, which is a helix whose radius changes with the value, or a torus. Of 1,330 cells with an ownership verdict, 19% of shapes are owned and 81% are inherited. Owned and inherited shapes move the output about equally often. Intervening on the shape retains approximately 61% of the effect of intervening on the full probe while using at most five dimensions, against a median of nine for the probe. Our results indicate that a probe verdict alone overstates what a model computes with, and we propose that probe results be reported as verdicts on all four claims rather than as a single accuracy.

[NLP-85] Capacity Allocation at the Source: Sparse Target Optimization for LLM Knowledge Editing NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在进行知识编辑时，因目标隐状态（target hidden state）构建不当导致的模型容量冲突与知识干扰问题。现有方法多聚焦于参数编辑阶段以保留原有知识，而本文指出上游目标隐状态的构造同样关键，直接影响模型有限容量空间的分配效率。其核心解决方案在于建立参数空间干扰与目标隐状态间干扰之间的理论关联，证明二者呈正相关关系；基于此，提出一种简单有效的ℓ₁正则化方法，通过剪枝每个知识向量的冗余“触须”（tentacles），仅保留关键成分，从而减少知识编辑对其他已有知识的影响。该方法显著提升了不同知识间的共存能力，实验验证了其在多种大模型和基准数据集上的有效性。
